articles.title: RegExtract: A Benchmark for PFAS Regulatory Information Extraction with LLMs
articles.abstract: Extracting structured information from regulatory documents is a critical but challenging task. Relevant facts are scattered across long, legally dense texts, and traceability of extracted facts to their source is essential for verification. With increasing awareness of the environmental and health impacts of per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS), regulatory documents have expanded significantly, varying in scope and product relevance, making interpretation challenging for manufacturers and policymakers. We introduce RegExtract, a benchmark for structured information extraction from PFAS regulatory documents, comprising 488 human-annotated field instances across 20 US state documents and 46 regulations. Each field instance includes a value and a provenance entry, yielding 976 entries in total. We define a typed, multi-field schema targeting key elements such as material definitions, permitted uses, and product exemptions, and propose provenance-aware evaluation metrics tailored to regulatory text. Through experiments with open- and closed-source LLMs across prompting strategies, document condensing methods, and schema partitioning approaches, we find that document identification fields remain challenging, and that field-specific few-shot examples improve extraction. This work lays the groundwork for AI tools for hazardous substance identification, question answering, and compliance monitoring. The code and data are available at https://github.com/IBM/PFAS-regulations.
articles.comment: Accepted to the AI for Law Workshop at ICML 2026, Seoul, South Korea
articles.titleCn: RegExtract：基于LLMs的PFAS监管信息提取基准
articles.abstractCn: 从监管文件中提取结构化信息是一项关键但具有挑战性的任务。相关事实分散在冗长且法律性强的文本中，而提取出的事实必须能够追溯到其来源以确保验证。随着对全氟和多氟烷基物质（PFAS）的环境和健康影响的日益关注，监管文件已显著增加，其范围和产品相关性各不相同，给制造商和政策制定者带来了解读的挑战。我们介绍了RegExtract，这是一个用于从PFAS监管文件中提取结构化信息的基准，包含20份美国州文件和46项法规中的488个人标注的字段实例。每个字段实例包括一个值和一个来源条目，总共产生976个条目。我们定义了一个类型化的多字段模式，针对材料定义、允许用途和产品豁免等关键元素，并提出了针对监管文本的来源感知评估指标。通过在不同提示策略、文档压缩方法和模式划分方法下使用开源和闭源的大型语言模型进行实验，我们发现文档识别字段仍然具有挑战性，而特定字段的少量样本示例可以提高提取效果。这项工作为危险物质识别、问答和合规监控的AI工具奠定了基础。代码和数据可在https://github.com/IBM/PFAS-regulations获取。

articles.title: Have You Been Convinced? A Neuro-symbolic Argumentation Reasoning Approach to Detecting Persuasiveness in ChangeMyView Discussions
articles.abstract: Argument structures represent how individual arguments interact within a discourse. However, leveraging these structures to infer meaningful knowledge remains challenging, as it requires a formal representation of how argumentative influence propagates across the structure. We propose Neuro-symbolic Argumentation Reasoning System (NARS) for performing persuasiveness detection directly from online discussions. The neural component employs retrieval-augmented iterative LLM reasoning to extract bipolar argument structures, while the symbolic component applies gradual argumentation semantics to propagate argumentative influence over the structure. Using the Webis-CMV-20 corpus, we construct CMV2BAS, a dataset of long, multi-threaded ChangeMyView discussions annotated with LLM-derived bipolar argument structures and labeled with delta events (view change vs.\ no change). We investigate whether gradual argumentation semantics can effectively detect persuasiveness, whether augmenting them with argument quality and graph-based centrality improves performance, and whether symbolic reasoning remains necessary in the presence of modern LLMs. NARS achieves F1=0.57 and AUC=0.56 under its best configuration, outperforming zero-shot Qwen3.6:27B and GPT-oss:20B. We identify support-dominant discussions and long argumentative chains as key failure modes limiting attack influence propagation. Our work demonstrates the feasibility of operationalizing formal gradual argumentation semantics over noisy real-world discourse for scalable macro-level persuasion analysis, while highlighting key challenges and directions for future research in neuro-symbolic argumentation reasoning. We release both CMV2BAS dataset and the NARS framework for public use.
articles.comment: Accepted and to be published in the Proceedings of the 25th International Conference on Knowledge Engineering and Knowledge Management (EKAW 2026)
articles.titleCn: 您已被说服？一种神经符号论证推理方法，用于检测ChangeMyView讨论中的说服力
articles.abstractCn: 论证结构表征了个体论证在语篇中的相互作用。然而，利用这些结构推断有意义的知识仍然具有挑战性，因为它需要形式化表征论证影响如何在结构中传播。我们提出了神经符号论证推理系统（NARS），用于直接从在线讨论中执行说服力检测。神经组件采用检索增强迭代大型语言模型（LLM）推理来提取双极论证结构，而符号组件应用渐进式论证语义来在结构中传播论证影响。使用Webis-CMV-20语料库，我们构建了CMV2BAS，这是一个包含长篇、多线程ChangeMyView讨论的数据集，其中包含由LLM推导的双极论证结构标注和用delta事件（观点改变与未改变）标记的标注。我们研究了渐进式论证语义是否能有效检测说服力，是否通过增加论证质量和基于图的中心性来提升性能，以及在现代LLM存在的情况下符号推理是否仍然必要。在最佳配置下，NARS实现了F1=0.57和AUC=0.56，优于零样本Qwen3.6:27B和GPT-oss:20B。我们识别出支持主导的讨论和长篇论证链是限制攻击影响传播的关键失效模式。我们的工作证明了在嘈杂的真实世界语篇中实现形式化渐进式论证语义以进行可扩展的宏观层次说服分析的可行性，同时突出了神经符号论证推理未来研究的关键挑战和方向。我们公开发布了CMV2BAS数据集和NARS框架。

articles.title: Select or Rewrite: Oracle-Guided Fine-Tuning for Generative ASR Post-Editing from N-Best Hypotheses
articles.abstract: Large language models can post-edit ASR by using linguistic context to compare N-best hypotheses and rewrite the transcript when needed, often improving WER without retraining the recognizer. However, prompt-only correction is brittle: it may over-edit when top-1 is correct and hallucinate when the reference is absent, and often needs very large models. We propose oracle-guided fine-tuning that turns N-best lists into supervision via three curated pools: corrections (reference in the list but not top-1) to teach selection, regularizers (top-1 correct) to discourage unnecessary rewrites, and hard negatives (reference absent) to suppress hallucination. Fine-tuning on this data provides more effective supervision than random subset fine-tuning for learning a hybrid select-or-rewrite policy, with the clearest gains from around 3B parameters on the proprietary dataset but less conclusive results on CommonVoice, a divergence suggesting that public read-speech text may overlap with LLM pretraining and mask genuine post-editing gains.
articles.titleCn: 基于Oracle指导的生成式ASR后编辑任务中N最佳假设的微调
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型可以通过利用语言上下文来比较N最佳假设，并在必要时重写文本，从而对语音识别结果进行后编辑，通常在不重新训练识别器的情况下提高词错误率。然而，仅通过提示进行校正的方法比较脆弱：当第一选择正确时可能会过度编辑，当参考文本缺失时可能会产生幻觉，并且通常需要非常大的模型。我们提出了基于预言机指导的微调方法，通过三个精心策划的池将N最佳列表转化为监督信息：校正池（列表中存在但不是第一选择）用于教授选择，正则化池（第一选择正确）用于抑制不必要的重写，以及困难负样本池（参考文本缺失）用于抑制幻觉。在上述数据上进行微调，对于学习混合选择或重写策略，其提供的监督效果优于随机子集微调，在专有数据集上从大约30亿参数开始效果最为显著，但在CommonVoice数据集上的结果则不够明确，这种差异表明公共朗读文本可能与大型语言模型的预训练内容重叠，从而掩盖了真实的后编辑收益。

articles.title: PAT: A Personality-Driven Augmentation and Transfer Learning Framework for Depression Detection on Social Media
articles.abstract: Depression is a prevalent mental disorder that affects millions worldwide, with early detection crucial for effective intervention. While exist?ing methods have achieved promising results in automated depression detection, they face two key limitations: (1) noise in post screening: symptom-based semantic screening is easily misled by superficial lexical patterns, thereby introducing false-positive posts; (2) weak op?timization of the post encoder: relying solely on coarse user-level supervision signals pre?vents models from capturing depressive cues within individual posts. To address these limita?tions, we propose PAT, a Personality-driven Augmentation and Transfer learning frame?work. In the first phase, PAT optimizes a post?level encoder via a fine-grained contrastive learning objective, utilizing LLM-based data augmentation driven by classic personality the?ories to alleviate data scarcity. In the second phase, the trained post-level scorer is deployed for high-quality post filtering, while its en?coder parameters are seamlessly transferred for user-level tasks. Extensive experiments demon?strate that PAT significantly outperforms exist?ing methods. Furthermore, PAT delivers multi?granular interpretability by tracing post-level mental-state trajectories and highlighting key symptoms, thereby offering reliable diagnostic evidence for clinical practice.
articles.titleCn: 基于人格驱动的社交媒体抑郁症检测增强与迁移学习框架：PAT
articles.abstractCn: 抑郁症是一种普遍存在的精神障碍，影响着全球数百万人口，早期发现对于有效干预至关重要。尽管现有的方法在自动化抑郁症检测方面取得了显著成果，但它们面临两个关键局限：(1) 帖子筛选中的噪声：基于症状的语义筛选容易受到表面词汇模式的误导，从而引入假阳性帖子；(2) 帖子编码器的弱优化：仅依赖粗粒度的用户级监督信号，阻碍了模型捕捉单个帖子中的抑郁线索。为解决这些局限，我们提出了PAT（人格驱动的增强与迁移学习框架）。在第一阶段，PAT通过细粒度对比学习目标优化帖子级编码器，利用基于大型语言模型的数据增强技术，并受经典人格理论驱动，以缓解数据稀缺问题。在第二阶段，训练好的帖子级评分器用于高质量帖子筛选，同时其编码器参数无缝迁移用于用户级任务。大量实验表明，PAT显著优于现有方法。此外，PAT通过追踪帖子级精神状态轨迹并突出关键症状，实现了多粒度可解释性，为临床实践提供可靠的诊断依据。

articles.title: What Drives AI Citations? Content, Retrieval and Model Knowledge in Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)
articles.abstract: Generative search engines such as ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity now decide which Web pages users see as sources, and a growing industry of generative engine optimization advises publishers on how to earn these citations. We study what shapes citation in two 90-day collections of answers to commercial questions in contrasting markets: 158,099 answers with 468,037 citations. Comparing pages of the same website, content matters in one way: pages whose title and paragraphs match the questions people ask are cited more, whereas FAQ blocks, structured data, summary boxes and page speed appear effective only across websites. Page properties nevertheless explain little of the variation between pages of a website. Replaying the questions through the engines' APIs shows why. Every page ChatGPT cites is one its own search retrieved, and which pages that search retrieves, for sub-queries the model rewrites on every answer and that rarely coincide with Google's or Bing's results, explains far more of the variation than page properties (32% against 2.8%). Content acts mainly through this step, by matching the engine's queries in meaning. The model's own knowledge shapes it too: ChatGPT writes brands it knows into its searches, prefers websites it knows, and names brands without any supporting page, and controlled experiments show that brand names reorder its rankings of products with identical facts. Pages are thus cited when searched; brands are also named when remembered. The findings replicate in a market of small B2B vendors. We release data and code.
articles.titleCn: 是什么驱动AI引用？生成引擎优化（GEO）中的内容、检索和模型知识
articles.abstractCn: 生成式搜索引擎如ChatGPT、Gemini和Perplexity现在决定用户看到的网页作为来源，一个不断增长的行业——生成式引擎优化——则向出版商提供如何获取这些引用的建议。我们研究了在两个对比鲜明的市场中，90天内对商业问题的回答集合中哪些因素塑造了引用：158,099个回答包含468,037次引用。比较同一网站的页面，内容以某种方式起作用：标题和段落与人们提问内容匹配的页面被引用更多，而FAQ区块、结构化数据、摘要框和页面速度仅在跨网站时有效。然而，页面属性仍然无法解释同一网站页面之间的差异。通过搜索引擎的API重放问题揭示了原因。ChatGPT引用的每个页面都是其自身搜索检索到的，而该搜索检索到的页面，对于模型在每次回答时重写的子查询，很少与谷歌或必应的结果一致，这比页面属性更能解释差异（32%对比2.8%）。内容主要通过这一步骤起作用，通过在意义上匹配搜索引擎的查询。模型的自身知识也塑造了它：ChatGPT在搜索中写入它所知道的品牌，偏爱它所知道的网站，并在没有支持页面的情况下命名品牌，受控实验表明品牌名称会重新排序具有相同事实的产品排名。因此，页面在被搜索时被引用；品牌在被记忆时也被命名。这一发现在小B2B供应商市场中得到了验证。我们发布了数据和代码。

articles.title: Toward System One Clinical Intelligence: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning and Counterfactual Explainability of Decision Foundation Models
articles.abstract: Automated disease classification from patient-reported symptoms requires balancing the speed of lightweight discriminative models against the contextual understanding and latency costs of autoregressive large language models (LLMs). Decision foundation models offer an alternative by mapping representations directly to candidate classes without free-form text generation. We adapt Clef-Flash, a 9-billion-parameter decision model built on a Qwen3.5 backbone, for 24-class disease classification on the Symptom2Disease benchmark. Using 4-bit quantized low-rank adaptation (QLoRA) with differential learning rates and a stratified split of 960 training and 240 test cases, the model achieves 95.42% diagnostic accuracy and a macro F1 score of 0.9551. This improves upon the reported zero-shot baselines of 61.67% for a remote API and 65.00% for a local unadapted initialization, and outperforms the ClinicalBERT baseline (90.90%). By evaluating candidate logits in a single forward pass without autoregressive decoding, inference takes under 80 milliseconds per record on a single GPU, yielding a reported 31-fold speedup over generative LLM baselines. To examine symptom-level evidence, we introduce a Leave-One-Symptom-Out (LOSO) counterfactual perturbation framework. Removing disease-defining symptom clauses in a psoriasis example reduces predicted-class confidence from 100.00% to 0.12% and shifts the prediction to impetigo with 99.59% confidence, while removing secondary systemic symptoms produces less than 0.01% change in confidence. These findings suggest that decision-based architectures can combine the linguistic capabilities of large foundation models with low-latency inference and symptom-level interpretability for clinical triage.
articles.titleCn: 迈向系统一临床智能：决策基础模型的参数高效微调和反事实可解释性
articles.abstractCn: 基于患者报告症状的自动化疾病分类需要在轻量级判别模型的快速性与大语言模型（LLM）的上下文理解能力和延迟成本之间取得平衡。决策基础模型通过将表示直接映射到候选类别，而非自由形式的文本生成，提供了一种替代方案。我们基于Qwen3.5主干网络构建的、拥有90亿参数的决策模型Clef-Flash，用于在Symptom2Disease基准数据集上进行24类疾病分类。采用4位量化低秩适配（QLoRA）技术，并结合差异学习率及960个训练案例和240个测试案例的分层划分，该模型实现了95.42%的诊断准确率和0.9551的宏观F1分数。这超越了此前报道的零样本基线：远程API的61.67%和本地未适配初始化的65.00%，并优于ClinicalBERT基线（90.90%）。通过在单次前向传播中评估候选logits，而无需自回归解码，单GPU上的推理时间少于80毫秒每条记录，相较于生成式LLM基线，实现了31倍的加速。为检验症状级别的证据，我们引入了留一症状剔除（LOSO）反事实扰动框架。在银屑病示例中，移除定义疾病的症状子句将预测类别置信度从100.00%降至0.12%，并将预测结果转变为脓疱疮，置信度为99.59%，而移除次要全身症状时，置信度变化小于0.01%。这些结果表明，基于决策的架构能够结合大型基础模型的语言能力、低延迟推理和症状级别的可解释性，用于临床分诊。

articles.title: UltraBERT: Beyond the Limit of BERT Pre-Training
articles.abstract: Recent bidirectional encoders have been modernized with innovations from causal large language models (LLMs). However, the pretraining recipe itself remains inherited from small-scale conventions, leaving encoders underoptimized, with no single model performing competitively across both classification and retrieval tasks. In this work, we investigate how far encoder performance can be pushed by revisiting core design choices in training, revealing three key findings: (1) Encoders saturate on downstream tasks beyond a few trillion tokens, indicating that additional compute past this point does not help. (2) Across model sizes, lower masking ratios benefit classification while higher ones benefit retrieval, contradicting prior work suggesting larger ratios for larger models. (3) Distillation with pruning improves classification at low masking ratios but degrades retrieval at high ones. Guided by these findings, we present UltraBERT, a single encoder that assigns separate LM heads to low and high masking ratios within a batch and restricts the distillation objective to the low ratio. To our knowledge, UltraBERT is the first encoder to achieve state of the art on both classification and retrieval tasks, reaching 91.0 on GLUE and 47.7 on BEIR. Together, these results show how far encoder performance can be pushed and provide a principled basis for compute allocation, masking ratio design, and knowledge transfer in bidirectional models.
articles.titleCn: UltraBERT：超越BERT预训练的极限
articles.abstractCn: 近期双向编码器通过因果大型语言模型（LLMs）的创新得到了现代化改造。然而，其预训练方案本身仍沿袭小规模惯例，导致编码器未得到充分优化，且没有单一模型能在分类和检索任务中同时表现出竞争力。在本工作中，我们研究了通过重新审视训练中的核心设计选择，编码器性能能被提升到何种程度，揭示了三个关键发现：（1）编码器在超过数千亿token的下游任务上达到饱和，表明在此点之后增加计算量并无帮助。（2）在模型规模方面，较低的掩码比例有利于分类任务，而较高的掩码比例有利于检索任务，这与先前认为较大模型应使用较大比例的观点相悖。（3）剪枝蒸馏在低掩码比例下提升分类性能，但在高掩码比例下损害检索性能。基于这些发现，我们提出了UltraBERT，这是一种单一编码器，它在批处理中为低和高掩码比例分配不同的语言模型头，并将蒸馏目标限制在低比例上。据我们所知，UltraBERT是首个在分类和检索任务上均达到最优性能的编码器，在GLUE上达到91.0分，在BEIR上达到47.7分。这些结果共同展示了编码器性能可以被提升到何种程度，并为双向模型中的计算分配、掩码比例设计和知识迁移提供了原则性基础。

articles.title: HodgePhaseNet: Discrete Hodge Decomposition of Semantic Flows in Transformer Attention
articles.abstract: WavePhaseNet introduced frequency-resolved semantic representations, QuantumPhaseNet introduced gauge-covariant phase connections, and ModularPhaseNet made a finite cyclic phase channel and its cycle holonomy computable in an ordinary Transformer. These constructions are complementary, yet they do not by themselves separate an observed collection of pairwise relations into a globally consistent direction, circulation around local compositions, and circulation that persists around a larger unfilled cycle. HodgePhaseNet addresses this separation by representing semantic transitions as an antisymmetric real-valued 1-cochain on a finite oriented simplicial complex. With vertex-edge incidence matrix $B_1$ and edge-face incidence matrix $B_2$, every such field has a unique orthogonal decomposition $Ω= B_1^TΦ+ B_2Ψ+ H$, where $B_1H=0$ and $B_2^TH=0$. The three component fields are unique even when their potentials are not. We give explicit projectors, a sparse implementation, integrability and gauge results, a verified numerical example, and a redesigned attention interface. The attention bias is defined on allowed ordered query-key pairs, remains consistent under arbitrary choices of edge orientation, and preserves a decoder's causal information boundary by constructing its complex from the visible prefix. Gauge invariance of the attention output is conditional on using invariant or appropriately compensated features. A simple difference of vertex embeddings has no coexact or harmonic component; a genuine relation encoder is therefore indispensable. Local circulation is not automatically contradiction, and harmonic flow is not automatically missing knowledge. These interpretations and any reduction in factual error require controlled empirical evaluation. This paper presents a mathematical and architectural proposal, not external natural-language performance results.
articles.titleCn: HodgePhaseNet：Transformer注意力机制中语义流的离散Hodge分解
articles.abstractCn: WavePhaseNet 引入了频率解析的语义表示，QuantumPhaseNet 引入了规范协变的相位连接，ModularPhaseNet 实现了有限循环相位通道及其循环 holonomy 在普通 Transformer 中的可计算性。这些构造是互补的，但它们本身并不能将观察到的成对关系集合分离为全局一致的方向、局部组合的循环以及围绕更大未填充循环的持续循环。HodgePhaseNet 通过将语义转换表示为有限定向单纯复形上的反对称实值1-链来解决这个问题。对于顶点-边关联矩阵 $B_1$ 和边-面关联矩阵 $B_2$，此类场具有唯一的正交分解 $Ω= B_1^TΦ+ B_2Ψ+ H$，其中 $B_1H=0$ 且 $B_2^TH=0$。这三个分量场即使在势函数不同时也是唯一的。我们提供了显式投影器、稀疏实现、可积性和规范结果、验证的数值示例以及重新设计的注意力接口。注意力偏差定义在允许的有序查询-键对上，在任意选择的边方向下保持一致，并通过从可见前缀构建其复形来保留解码器的因果信息边界。注意力输出的规范不变性取决于使用不变特征或适当补偿的特征。顶点嵌入的简单差值没有共精确或调和分量；因此，一个真正的关联编码器是必不可少的。局部循环并不自动矛盾，调和流也不自动缺失知识。这些解释以及任何事实性错误的减少都需要受控的实证评估。本文提出的是一个数学和架构上的提议，而非外部的自然语言性能结果。

articles.title: HiPAD: A Unified Gait, Audio-Visual, and Personality Fusion Network for Depression Detection, with a Hierarchical Personality Ablation and the Calibration Limits of Domain-Adapted LLMs
articles.abstract: We present HiPAD, a single fusion network submitted to all six sub-tracks of the MPDD-AVG 2026 depression-detection challenge, covering the Elder and Young cohorts and three modality sets (gait, audio-visual, and both), each combined with personality descriptions. The network encodes each available modality with a shared BiLSTM, zero-pads absent modalities, and applies cross-modal attention only when at least two of gait, audio and video are present. Personality, which dominates our results, is kept out of the attention and fused by concatenation. Because the architecture is identical in every sub-track, differences between them reflect the data rather than the model, and we use this to study three questions. Our main finding is that the personality description, roughly 150 tokens about who the subject is, carries more depression signal than audio, video, and gait combined: gait plus personality alone (TLS 0.647) beats every configuration that includes audio and video. First, a four-level ablation of the personality description (L0-L3) quantifies this: removing every personality-derived feature, including the Big Five scores that earlier MPDD ablations keep, lowers the Track-Level Score by 0.499 to 0.507 and leaves the model at chance. Second, domain-adapting the personality encoder with LoRA (7B) or QLoRA (72B) on PHQ-8/9 data raises binary Cohen's $κ$ by 0.13 but lowers the overall score by distorting the PHQ-9 regression; a frozen RoBERTa-large encoder does better at this sample size. Third, at fixed architecture, handcrafted clinical features (eGeMAPS, OpenFace action units) outperform generic deep features (wav2vec2, DenseNet) on the audio-visual tracks. The unified system reaches a cross-track G-Score of 0.482; with under 100 subjects per cohort, the limiting factors are the size of the representation and the calibration of the outputs, not the choice of architecture.

articles.titleCn: HiPAD：一种用于抑郁症检测的统一步态、视听和人格融合网络，具有层级人格消融和领域自适应LLM的校准极限
articles.abstractCn: 我们提出了HiPAD，一个针对MPDD-AVG 2026抑郁症检测挑战赛所有六个子赛道提交的单融合网络，涵盖老年和青年队列以及三种模态集（步态、视听和两者结合），每种模态集均与人格描述相结合。该网络使用共享的BiLSTM对每种可用模态进行编码，对缺失模态进行零填充，并且仅在步态、音频和视频中至少有两种存在时才应用跨模态注意力。人格描述（约占150个词，描述被试者是谁）在我们的结果中占主导地位，被排除在注意力机制之外，并通过拼接进行融合。由于架构在所有子赛道中都是相同的，因此它们之间的差异反映了数据而非模型，我们利用这一点来研究三个问题。我们的主要发现是，人格描述比音频、视频和步态结合携带更多的抑郁症信号：仅步态加上人格描述（TLS 0.647）优于包含音频和视频的任何配置。首先，对人格描述进行四级消融（L0-L3）量化了这一点：移除所有基于人格的特征，包括先前MPDD消融保留的大五人格分数，将Track-Level Score降低0.499至0.507，并将模型降至随机水平。其次，在PHQ-8/9数据上使用LoRA（7B）或QLoRA（72B）对人格编码器进行领域自适应，将二元Cohen's κ提高0.13，但通过扭曲PHQ-9回归降低了整体分数；冻结的RoBERTa-large编码器在这个样本量上表现更好。第三，在固定架构下，手工制作的临床特征（eGeMAPS、OpenFace动作单元）在视听赛道上优于通用深度特征（wav2vec2、DenseNet）。统一系统达到了跨赛道G-Score 0.482；在队列中每个队列少于100名被试的情况下，限制因素是表示的大小和输出的校准，而不是架构的选择。

articles.title: AlphaRLM: Aligning Language Models for Literature-Grounded Symbolic Factor Discovery
articles.abstract: Formulaic alpha mining seeks to discover executable expressions that capture predictive market signals in a vast, noisy search space. Recent LLM-based approaches use prompting, iterative search, or seed-factor evolution, leaving direct factor construction through policy learning less explored. To address this, we introduce AlphaRLM, a reinforcement-learning framework that trains LLMs to construct executable symbolic factors from financial literature without input factor expressions. AlphaRLM incorporates Literature-Guided Operator Assembly (LEGO), which conditions factor construction on literature-derived ideas and executable operators, providing semantic priors for exploration. It further aligns the generation policy with market feedback through executable-validity and grouped-return-separation rewards that capture non-monotonic structures across factor quantiles. Extensive experiments on CSI 300, CSI 1000, and S&P 500 show that AlphaRLM outperforms strong factor-mining and LLM-based baselines in annualized excess return. Notably, the 8B model achieves strong cross-market performance, highlighting the promise of literature-conditioned, market-aligned factor generation.
articles.titleCn: AlphaRLM：用于基于文学符号因子发现的语言模型对齐
articles.abstractCn: 公式化α挖掘旨在在一个庞大且嘈杂的搜索空间中发现能够捕捉预测性市场信号的可行表达式。近期基于大型语言模型（LLM）的方法采用提示、迭代搜索或种子-因子进化，而通过策略学习直接构建因子的方法则较少探索。为此，我们引入AlphaRLM，这是一个强化学习框架，用于训练LLM从金融文献中构建无需输入因子表达式的可行符号因子。AlphaRLM结合了文献引导算子组装（LEGO），该机制基于文献衍生思想和可行算子来构建因子，为探索提供语义先验。它进一步通过可行有效性及分组回报分离的奖励机制来使生成策略与市场反馈相一致，这些奖励机制能够捕捉因子分位数间的非单调结构。在CSI 300、CSI 1000和标普500上的大量实验表明，AlphaRLM在年化超额回报上优于强大的因子挖掘和基于LLM的基线模型。值得注意的是，8B模型展现出优异的跨市场性能，突显了文献条件化、市场对齐因子生成的潜力。

articles.title: What Survives When Activation Steering Is Used as Memory
articles.abstract: Activation steering has recently been used as a memory for skills: past experiences of an agent are stored as steering vectors and retrieved later. Facts and preferences about the user are assumed to need text instead. We test that assumption with a training-free activation memory beside a frozen LLM. The change an experience causes in late-layer states is stored as a shift, filed under a whitened key for the conversation's gist, and added back in a later session only when the gist matches. We argue that such a shift is a fixed average of an effect that attention, in context, recomputes for every question, so only question-independent content can survive. In a pre-registered study on Qwen3.5-2B and 9B, with judges from four model families, the memory is selective (about 98% of unrelated replies are unchanged), but facts are stored as the word to say, in the last layers only, and are almost never used (at most 15% clean use, against 96-98% in context). Leanings transfer only in a narrow strength window. Most strikingly, the reference subtracted when writing a preference decides whether its concept or its direction survives: unless the opposite is subtracted, a stored dislike is recalled as a like.
articles.titleCn: 当使用激活引导作为内存时，什么会留存？
articles.abstractCn: 激活引导最近被用作技能的存储：智能体的过去经验被存储为引导向量，并在稍后检索。关于用户的事实和偏好则被认为需要文本。我们通过在冻结的大型语言模型旁边设置一个无训练的激活记忆来检验这一假设。经验对后期层状态造成的变化被存储为偏移量，在对话主旨的白化键下进行索引，并在稍后的会话中仅在主旨匹配时才重新添加。我们认为这种偏移量是注意力在上下文中为每个问题重新计算的效应的固定平均值，因此只有与问题无关的内容才能留存。在一项针对Qwen3.5-2B和9B的预先注册研究中，由四个模型系列的裁判进行评估，该记忆具有选择性（约98%的无关联回复保持不变），但事实仅以要说的话的形式存储在最后层，且几乎从未被使用（最多15%的干净使用率，相比之下，上下文中的使用率为96-98%）。倾向仅在狭窄的强度窗口内转移。最引人注目的是，在撰写偏好时被减去的参考决定了其概念还是其方向是否留存：除非减去相反的内容，否则存储的厌恶在回忆时会被视为喜爱。

articles.title: Do Personalized LLMs Need the Whole Conversation? Matching the Full History with Only 5% of Its Text via Relevance-Filtered Context
articles.abstract: Personalized assistants accumulate long conversation histories, and passing the whole history to an LLM with every request is costly. We show that it is also unnecessary. On PersonaMem-v2 (180 questions), with GPT-5.6-terra and Claude Opus 5.5 as judges, a relevance-filtered context, built by sentence-level retrieval that ranks the history by similarity to the current request and stops at a fixed budget, matches full-history accuracy with only 5% of the text, cutting the judge's input about 20-fold. An LLM summary of the same length performs on par, but it needs an LLM to read the entire history, whereas retrieval needs only a small embedding model. While both sentence-level retrieval and LLM summary perform strongly, retrieval does so while placing the relevant evidence in the context for only 61% of the questions, and an oracle given only that evidence beats the full history by 15.6 points, making better context selection a promising path to surpassing the full history.
articles.titleCn: 个性化大型语言模型是否需要整个对话？通过相关性过滤的上下文，仅用5%的文本匹配完整历史
articles.abstractCn: 个性化助手会积累大量的对话历史，每次请求都传递整个历史给大型语言模型（LLM）成本很高。我们证明这其实是不必要的。在PersonaMem-v2（180个问题）上，使用GPT-5.6-terra和Claude Opus 5.5作为评判者，通过句子级检索构建的相关性过滤上下文——该上下文根据历史与当前请求的相似性进行排序，并在固定预算处停止——仅使用5%的文本就能达到完整历史的准确性，将评判者的输入减少了20倍。同样长度的LLM摘要表现相当，但它需要LLM阅读整个历史，而检索只需要一个小型嵌入模型。虽然句子级检索和LLM摘要都表现优异，但检索仅在61%的问题中将相关证据放入上下文中，而仅给定这些证据的“神谕”比完整历史高出15.6分，这使得更好的上下文选择成为超越完整历史的潜在路径。

articles.title: Predicting how model propensities generalize out of distribution
articles.abstract: How do language models generalize from their training data? This is a central challenge for alignment: models reliably learn their training distribution given enough samples, but we want models that behave well when deployed in new contexts. We study out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization of propensities. Our central experiment uses a range of elicitation techniques -- system prompting, few-shot learning, SFT on reference answers, and GRPO -- to increase a target propensity in a model, then measures how it spills over onto others across the resulting cross-elicitation matrices. We find that spillover is highly correlated between models when the same elicitation technique is used, but our SFT and GRPO runs induce different spillover profiles. Elicitation of benign traits can sometimes generalize towards undesired traits, for example a model trained to claim that it is sentient often becomes more power-seeking. We further find that spillover partially resembles trait correlations found in humans and identify three clusters of traits that account for about half of the variance using exploratory factor analysis (EFA). Across many elicitation runs, we observe that models change in characteristic ways that don't depend on the targeted trait, a phenomenon we refer to as drift. Drift moves Qwen3.5-9B towards its base model. When investigating if LLMs are able to predict spillover, we find that Claude Opus 5.5 predicts spillover slightly better than the models themselves, but worse than data-driven approaches using alternative elicitation methods or models. Overall, no single dominant predictor emerges, and generalization remains hard to predict. Code and data are available at https://github.com/nielsrolf/propensity-spillover.
articles.titleCn: 预测模型倾向性在分布外泛化
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型如何从其训练数据中泛化？这是对齐的核心挑战：模型在有足够样本的情况下可靠地学习其训练分布，但我们希望模型在新环境中表现良好。我们研究倾向性的分布外（OOD）泛化。我们的核心实验使用了一系列诱导技术——系统提示、少样本学习、基于参考答案的SFT和GRPO——来增加模型中的目标倾向性，然后测量它在生成的交叉诱导矩阵中如何蔓延到其他倾向性上。我们发现，当使用相同的诱导技术时，不同模型之间的蔓延高度相关，但我们的SFT和GRPO运行产生了不同的蔓延模式。诱导良性特质有时会泛化到不希望的特质上，例如，一个被训练声称自己有意识的模型往往会变得更加追求权力。我们进一步发现，蔓延部分类似于人类中的特质相关性，并使用探索性因素分析（EFA）识别出三个解释了约一半方差的特质集群。在许多诱导运行中，我们观察到模型以不依赖于目标特质的方式发生变化，我们将这种现象称为漂移。漂移将Qwen3.5-9B推向其基础模型。在调查LLM是否能够预测蔓延时，我们发现Claude Opus 5.5比模型本身预测蔓延稍好，但比使用替代诱导方法或模型的基于数据的 approaches 差。总的来说，没有单一的占主导地位的预测者出现，泛化仍然难以预测。代码和数据可在 https://github.com/nielsrolf/propensity-spillover 获取。

articles.title: FidelityQ: Preserving Predictive Fidelity in Ultra-Low-Bit Language Model Quantization
articles.abstract: Ultra-low-bit scalar quantization offers a regular arithmetic structure for efficient deployment of large language models, but preserving predictive behavior at extreme precision remains challenging: with only a few reconstruction levels, accurate weight representation must translate into consistent predictions from a small calibration set. We propose FidelityQ, a scalar quantization framework that preserves predictive fidelity at weight precisions down to 2 bits. For accurate quantization, we introduce Information-Aligned Analytic Coding (IAC), which shapes each weight row toward a centered symmetric source via randomized Hadamard mixing and fits a mirrored four-level minimum-distortion quantizer to its empirical weights. Every level set in this family decomposes exactly into two sign-valued bases with associated scales, combining source-adaptive reconstruction with lookup-free decoding compatible with scaled integer arithmetic. Our analysis further shows that residual predictive discrepancies are heavy-tailed and concentrate on tokens the teacher predicts confidently, motivating Knowledge-Intensive Calibration (KIC) for consistent quantization. KIC ranks sequences by the tail of token-wise teacher-student divergence, allocates a limited calibration budget to the highest-scoring samples, and restores predictive agreement by updating only quantization levels and scales under teacher supervision, keeping pretrained weights frozen. Experiments on the LLaMA and Qwen families demonstrate the effectiveness of FidelityQ in weight-only and joint quantization settings. On LLaMA-2-7B, FidelityQ achieves a WikiText2 perplexity of 6.62 at W2A16 and improves the prior state-of-the-art W2A4KV4 result from 8.31 to 6.96, while reducing linear-layer weight memory by 8.0x relative to FP16.
articles.titleCn: FidelityQ：超低比特语言模型量化中的预测保真度保持
articles.abstractCn: 超低比特标量量化为大型语言模型的效率部署提供了规则的算术结构，但在极端精度下保持预测行为仍然具有挑战性：仅通过少量重构级别，精确的权重表示必须转化为小校准集的一致预测。我们提出了FidelityQ，一种在权重精度低至2比特时仍能保持预测保真度的标量量化框架。为实现精确量化，我们引入了信息对齐解析编码（IAC），通过随机Hadamard混合将每个权重行塑造成以中心对称源为导向，并对其经验权重适配一个镜像四级最小失真量化器。该系列中的每个级别集精确分解为两个带相关尺度的符号值基，结合了源自适应重构与无查找解码，兼容缩放整数运算。我们的分析进一步表明，残差预测差异呈现重尾分布，集中在教师自信预测的标记上，这促使我们提出知识密集型校准（KIC）以实现一致量化。KIC通过标记的教师-学生差异的尾部对序列进行排序，将有限的校准预算分配给得分最高的样本，并在教师监督下仅通过更新量化级别和尺度来恢复预测一致性，同时冻结预训练权重。在LLaMA和Qwen系列上的实验展示了FidelityQ在仅权重和联合量化设置中的有效性。在LLaMA-2-7B上，FidelityQ在W2A16下实现了6.62的WikiText2困惑度，并将先前的最先进结果W2A4KV4从8.31提升至6.96，同时相对于FP16将线性层权重内存减少了8.0倍。

articles.title: SkillForgeBench: Evaluating Agent Reliability Grounded in Agent Skill Specifications
articles.abstract: Evaluating an agent's ability to strictly satisfy diverse and procedurally complex requirements is essential to determining its practical reliability. Conducting such an evaluation demands agentic tasks that reconcile broad domain coverage with deep procedural complexity. Existing paradigms face a fundamental trade-off: expert-curated benchmarks achieve procedural depth but suffer from domain diversity bottlenecks, whereas crowdsourced benchmarks span diverse scenarios but lack execution rigor. To resolve this tension, we present SkillForgeBench, which leverages agent skills as unifying execution blueprints across three co-designed stages: (1) Resource Preparation uses domain-balanced skills to guide artifact retrieval, establishing broad workflow coverage; (2) Skill-driven Task Synthesis employs skills as procedural anchors to partition artifact roles, synthesize naturalistic task instructions, and package sandboxed scenarios for deep procedural execution; and (3) Holistic Evaluation Design translates skill-embedded requirements into fine-grained completion and process rubrics to enable strict requirement-level scoring. Comprising 842 sandboxed tasks across five major professional domains, SkillForgeBench reveals a steep capability hierarchy among eight mainstream agents, led by Opus 4.8 ($40.9\%$ strict completion). Requiring all constrains satisfaction uncovers severe capability bottlenecks across all model tiers that remain masked under individual rubric pass rates ($70.0\%$ to $85.7\%$ vs. $12.6\%$ to $40.9\%$). Crucially, under the external guidance from skills, top-tier agents obtain larger gains than low-tier agents (i.e., $Δ19.2\%$ for Opus 4.8 vs. $Δ5.8\%$ for Haiku 4.5). Finally, agents satisfy process rubrics far less frequently than completion rubrics (under $3\%$ for Haiku 4.5), proving that completion-only checks overestimate real-world agent reliability.
