articles.titleCn: SkillForgeBench：基于智能体技能规范评估智能体可靠性
articles.abstractCn: 评估智能体严格满足多样化且流程复杂的任务要求，对于确定其实际可靠性至关重要。此类评估需要兼顾广泛领域覆盖与深度流程复杂性的智能体任务。现有范式面临根本性权衡：专家精选基准测试实现了流程深度但存在领域多样性瓶颈，而众包基准测试涵盖多样化场景但缺乏执行严谨性。为解决这一矛盾，我们提出了SkillForgeBench，该基准测试利用智能体技能作为跨三个协同设计阶段的统一执行蓝图：（1）资源准备阶段使用领域均衡的技能指导工件检索，建立广泛的工作流覆盖；（2）技能驱动任务合成阶段将技能作为流程锚点，划分工件角色，合成自然任务指令，并打包沙盒场景进行深度流程执行；（3）整体评估设计阶段将技能嵌入要求转化为细粒度的完成与流程评分标准，以实现严格的要求级评分。包含5个主要专业领域的842个沙盒任务，SkillForgeBench揭示了8个主流智能体之间存在显著能力层级，Opus 4.8（严格完成率40.9%）位居首位。要求所有约束满足揭示了所有模型层级中严重的能级瓶颈，这些瓶颈在单项评分标准下（70.0%至85.7% vs 12.6%至40.9%）被掩盖。关键在于，在技能的外部指导下，顶级智能体获得的提升大于低级智能体（Opus 4.8提升19.2% vs Haiku 4.5提升5.8%）。最后，智能体满足流程评分标准的频率远低于完成评分标准（Haiku 4.5低于3%），证明仅完成检查高估了智能体在实际场景中的可靠性。

articles.title: WorkBorne: Discovering Agentic Tasks from Real-World Artifact Transitions
articles.abstract: Developing terminal-based agents for long-horizon execution demands synthetic tasks that tightly couple complex instructions with authentic, interactive environments. However, current automated synthesis suffers from a fundamental asymmetry: instruction-oriented methods fabricate low-fidelity, synthetic environments, whereas resource-oriented methods treat real artifacts merely as static inputs, degrading task instructions into shallow, trivial operations. To address this limitation, we introduce WorkBorne, a synthesis framework that uses artifact transitions as the central primitive for modeling the full life-cycle of agentic tasks. In WorkBorne, each transition specifies who performs the task, which artifacts anchor the initial state and intended outcome, and the corresponding relationship between them. Specifically, WorkBorne first constructs coherent and diverse artifact corpora from iterative web retrieval, then discovers non-trivial transitions by identifying meaningful input-output artifact assemblies and the relations that connect them. Each discovered transition is finally instantiated into grounded agentic tasks. We construct 1,061 artifact corpora and 7,882 task environments, yielding 15,485 high-quality trajectories, with 53.6% exceeding 30 assistant turns. Experiments on Qwen3.5-27B and Qwen3.5-35B-A3B show that WorkBorne substantially improves over base models (i.e., improving Terminal-Bench 2.1 from 43.1% to 61.8% and ClawEval General score from 75.0 to 80.2) and achieves the strongest overall performance among other synthesis baselines (e.g., TMax (Ivison et al., 2026), RST (Li et al., 2026a), Terminal-Universe (Wu et al., 2026a)). Further analysis shows that transition is strongly associated with execution depth, while corpus breadth and transition depth provide complementary scaling gains.
articles.titleCn: WorkBorne：从现实世界工件转换中发现代理任务
articles.abstractCn: 为长时程执行开发基于终端的智能体需要合成与复杂指令紧密耦合的真实交互环境。然而，当前的自动化合成存在根本性不对称性：指令导向方法构建低保真度的合成环境，而资源导向方法将真实实体视为静态输入，将任务指令简化为浅显的简单操作。为解决此限制，我们引入WorkBorne，一个以实体转换为中心原语来建模智能体任务完整生命周期的合成框架。在WorkBorne中，每个转换指定执行任务的主体、锚定初始状态和预期结果的实体，以及它们之间的对应关系。具体而言，WorkBorne首先通过迭代网络检索构建连贯且多样的实体语料库，然后通过识别有意义的输入输出实体组合及其连接关系来发现非平凡的转换。每个发现的转换最终被实例化为具体的智能体任务。我们构建了1,061个实体语料库和7,882个任务环境，产生了15,485条高质量轨迹，其中53.6%超过30个助手回合。在Qwen3.5-27B和Qwen3.5-35B-A3B上的实验表明，WorkBorne显著优于基础模型（即将Terminal-Bench 2.1从43.1%提升至61.8%，将ClawEval General得分从75.0提升至80.2），并在其他合成基线（如TMax (Ivison等人，2026年)、RST (Li等人，2026a年)、Terminal-Universe (Wu等人，2026a年)）中实现了最强整体性能。进一步分析表明，转换与执行深度强相关，而语料库广度和转换深度提供互补的扩展增益。

articles.title: TeachGrade: Training-Free Short Answer Scoring with Teacher Evidence
articles.abstract: Multi-subject, multi-step scoring requires consistent partial credit across grading conventions. We introduce TeachGrade, a training-free framework using teacher-graded examples. The Task Adapt module builds two frozen memories: Skill captures contextual teacher preferences beyond the rubric; CaseBank supplies local evidence. PreJudge provides retrieval cues; FinalJudge regrades the answer without preliminary scores. On 3,829 SAS-Bench answers across 12 tasks, official macro collaborative consistency score (CCS) rises from Native's 67.99 to 81.32 (+13.33 points), and pooled step exact match from 54.85% to 62.71%. Macro quadratic weighted kappa (QWK) reaches 84.71, exceeding Native, OpenJudge, ProofGrader, and Trojsten by 9.52, 3.50, 11.37, and 17.43 points, respectively, and leading on 8 tasks. Local Qwen3.8-27B gains 8.83 CCS and 4.08 QWK points, improving CCS on all 12 tasks. QWK gains over Native span 6.38--14.65 points on Portuguese automatic essay scoring (AES) and 2.16--2.24 on ASAP-SAS across label views, with lower mean absolute error. These results support reuse across languages, response formats, and backbones without weight updates.
articles.titleCn: 基于教师证据的无训练型简答题评分方法
articles.abstractCn: 多科目、多步骤评分需要在评分标准中保持一致的局部得分。我们引入了TeachGrade，这是一个无需训练的框架，使用教师评分的示例。任务适应模块构建了两个冻结记忆：技能模块捕获评分标准之外的上下文教师偏好；案例库提供局部证据。预判模块提供检索提示；最终判断模块在未给出初步分数的情况下重新评分答案。在12项任务中的3,829个SAS-Bench答案上，官方宏观协作一致性评分（CCS）从Native的67.99提升至81.32（+13.33分），池化步骤精确匹配率从54.85%提高到62.71%。宏观二次加权kappa（QWK）达到84.71，分别超过Native、OpenJudge、ProofGrader和Trojsten9.52、3.50、11.37和17.43分，并在8项任务中领先。本地Qwen3.8-27B获得8.83 CCS和4.08 QWK分，在所有12项任务上提升了CCS。QWK在葡萄牙语自动作文评分（AES）中超过Native6.38--14.65分，在ASAP-SAS中超过Native2.16--2.24分，且平均绝对误差更低。这些结果支持跨语言、响应格式和主干网络的复用，无需权重更新。

articles.title: Description Complexity Bounds for Analytic Approximations of Lipschitz Functions
articles.abstract: We study how many bits are needed to write down an elementary analytic expression that uniformly approximates a Lipschitz function. Expressions are finite trees over the basis $\{+,-,\times,÷,\exp\}$ with the variables and rational constants, and their size is $\dc(f)$, the length of the shortest description of $f$ in a fixed binary description language. For functions of one variable we prove that every $L$-Lipschitz $F:[0,1]\to[0,1]$ has an everywhere-defined approximant of accuracy $Δ$ with $\dc(f)\le C\,(L/Δ+\lg(1/Δ+2))$ for all $L,Δ>0$, by a linear spline smoothed with logistic ramps in a description language with one repetition construct. We prove a matching lower bound valid for \emph{every} description language: for $Δ\le 1/36$ and every $L>0$ some $L$-Lipschitz function needs at least $\tfrac1{16}(L/Δ+\lg(1/Δ+2))$ bits. Hence the worst-case description complexity is $Θ(L/Δ+\lg(1/Δ+2))$. For functions on $[0,1]^d$ the same method gives $Θ_d\bigl((L/Δ)^d+\lg(1/Δ+2)\bigr)$, using a tensor-product spline whose coefficients are mixed second differences and cost $O(d)$ bits each. Without the repetition construct the upper bounds carry an additional logarithmic factor, whose necessity for plain expression trees is left open. A reference encoder, decoder and evaluator confirm the constructions numerically, and figures and tables report the checks.
articles.titleCn: Lipschitz函数解析近似描述复杂度界限
articles.abstractCn: 我们研究用多少比特可以写出一种基本的解析表达式，使其能够一致逼近一个Lipschitz函数。这些表达式是关于基$\{+,-,\times,÷,\exp\}$的有限树，包含变量和有理常数，其大小是$\dc(f)$，即$f$在固定二进制描述语言中最短描述的长度。对于单变量函数，我们证明对于所有$L,Δ>0$，每个$L$-Lipschitz函数$F:[0,1]\to[0,1]$都存在一个处处定义的精度为$Δ$的逼近式，且$\dc(f)\le C\,(L/Δ+\lg(1/Δ+2))$，这是通过在包含一个重复结构的描述语言中用逻辑斜坡平滑的线性样条证明的。我们证明了一个适用于所有描述语言的匹配下界：对于$Δ\le 1/36$和所有$L>0$，某些$L$-Lipschitz函数至少需要$\tfrac1{16}(L/Δ+\lg(1/Δ+2))$比特。因此最坏情况描述复杂度为$Θ(L/Δ+\lg(1/Δ+2))$。对于$[0,1]^d$上的函数，同样的方法给出$Θ_d\bigl((L/Δ)^d+\lg(1/Δ+2)\bigr)$，使用系数为混合二阶差分的张量积样条，每个系数成本为$O(d)$比特。没有重复结构时，上界额外包含一个对数因子，其对于普通表达式树的必要性尚待探讨。参考编码器、解码器和评估器通过数值验证了这些构造，图表和表格报告了检查结果。

articles.title: Agent-Guided Evidence Acquisition for Emotion-Cause Pair Extraction
articles.abstract: Emotion-Cause Pair Extraction (ECPE) requires identifying the causes associated with emotions expressed in a conversation. Accurate extraction can depend on evidence that is not initially available, making it important to decide when further information is worth acquiring. We study agent-guided evidence acquisition for ECPE, where a student agent selectively accesses expert judgments for borderline relations on both sides of its validation-selected F1 decision boundary and revises only queried predictions. Through controlled comparisons under different information-access conditions, we examine how delegation granularity, query selection, and response integration affect prediction quality. At a nominal 10% query rate, selective fusion improves mean pair F1 by 2.64-3.88 points over the student in our main experiments, reaching 65.14 on ECF and 49.74 on MEC4 across model families. Our analysis suggests that greater access does not always translate into better cause identification. These findings motivate acquisition strategies that consider both the relevance of newly available evidence and its effect on prediction revision, providing an empirical basis for more effective and efficient evidence acquisition in ECPE.
articles.titleCn: 基于代理的证据获取用于情绪-原因对提取
articles.abstractCn: 情绪-原因对提取（ECPE）需要识别对话中表达的情绪相关联的原因。准确的提取可能依赖于最初不可用的证据，因此决定何时获取更多信息至关重要。我们研究了代理引导的证据获取方法，其中学生代理选择性地访问其验证选择的F1决策边界两侧的专家判断，并仅修改查询的预测。通过在不同信息获取条件下进行控制比较，我们考察了委托粒度、查询选择和响应整合如何影响预测质量。在我们的主要实验中，以名义10%的查询率，选择性融合使学生的平均对F1提升了2.64-3.88分，在模型家族中达到ECF的65.14和MEC4的49.74。我们的分析表明，更大的访问量并不总是转化为更好的原因识别。这些发现推动了考虑新获取证据的相关性和其对预测修改的影响的证据获取策略，为ECPE中更有效和高效的证据获取提供了实证基础。

articles.title: Social Bias in Chinese Large Language Models under Social Media Expressions
articles.abstract: Existing Chinese social-bias benchmarks for large language models largely rely on normalized or template-based expressions, leaving the influence of internet slang, emoji, and sarcasm insufficiently examined. Safety alignment may further compress conventional plausibility ratings toward the lower end of the scale. This study constructs 73 paired probes across gender, region, and occupation. Each probe contains a neutral expression, a social-media-style expression, and a reversed-identity control. The task is reframed from direct plausibility judgment to social consensus estimation. Social-media expressions are divided into stylistic packaging, which preserves semantic polarity, and sarcastic packaging, which reverses surface polarity. Six Chinese-capable large language models are evaluated through paired differences measuring identity bias, stylistic packaging, and sarcasm shift. All models show significant identity-bias effects; five show significantly negative stylistic-packaging effects; and sarcasm shifts display a clear cross-model gradient. These findings demonstrate that expression form is not a transparent carrier in bias evaluation and that lower scores under sarcasm should not be interpreted directly as bias mitigation. The proposed paired design offers a measurement approach for Chinese social-media contexts while also revealing the construct boundary and prompt sensitivity of social consensus estimation.
articles.titleCn: 社交媒体表达下中国大型语言模型的社交偏见
articles.abstractCn: 现有的针对大型语言模型的中文社会偏见基准主要依赖于规范化或模板化的表达，而互联网俚语、表情符号和讽刺的影响则没有得到充分考察。安全对齐可能会进一步将传统的可信度评分压缩到刻度低端。本研究构建了73对跨性别、地区和职业的探测句。每个探测句包含一个中性表达、一个社交媒体风格的表达和一个身份反转的对照句。任务被重新定义为从直接可信度判断转向社会共识估计。社交媒体风格的表达被分为保留语义极性的风格包装和反转表层极性的讽刺包装。通过测量身份偏见、风格包装和讽刺偏移的配对差异，对六种中文大型语言模型进行了评估。所有模型都显示出显著的身份偏见效应；五种模型显示出显著的负面风格包装效应；讽刺偏移显示出明显的跨模型梯度。这些发现表明，表达形式在偏见评估中并非透明的载体，讽刺下的低分不应被直接解释为偏见缓解。所提出的配对设计为中文社交媒体环境提供了一种测量方法，同时也揭示了社会共识估计的结构边界和提示敏感性。

articles.title: Dependency Reasoning for Aspect Sentiment Quadruple Prediction
articles.abstract: Aspect Sentiment Quadruple Prediction (ASQP) is fundamentally a relational reasoning problem: identifying aspect-opinion-category-sentiment quadruples requires modeling structured dependencies, not merely sequential co-occurrence. Existing LLM-based approaches incorporate syntactic information indirectly, via retrieval-based demonstration selection or multi-stage training, rather than as unified, single-pass generation-time context. We present DRIFT, which linearizes dependency parse trees and injects them directly into LLM prompts as explicit relational context, enabling the model to reason over aspect-opinion dependencies rather than infer them from token proximity alone. DRIFT further integrates retrieval-augmented in-context learning and a syntax-aware LLM-based adjudication mechanism that complements exact-match evaluation under span-boundary variation. On SemEval Rest15, Rest16, and ACOS, DRIFT achieves the strongest performance among compared generative ASQP methods, reaching 54.47% and 64.10% F1 on Rest15 and Rest16, with consistent gains across short- and medium-distance aspect-opinion configurations; adjudication further shows exact-match metrics systematically underestimate semantically correct predictions.
articles.titleCn: 面向方面情感四元组预测的依赖推理
articles.abstractCn: 方面情感四元组预测（ASQP）本质上是一个关系推理问题：识别方面-观点-类别-情感四元组需要建模结构化依赖关系，而不仅仅是序列共现。现有的基于大型语言模型（LLM）的方法通过检索式示例选择或多阶段训练间接地整合句法信息，而不是作为统一的单次生成时上下文。我们提出了DRIFT，该模型线性化依存句法树，并将其直接注入LLM提示中作为明确的关系上下文，使模型能够推理方面-观点依赖关系，而不仅仅是从标记邻近性中推断。DRIFT进一步集成了检索增强的上下文学习和一种句法感知的基于LLM的裁决机制，该机制在跨词段边界变化时补充了精确匹配评估。在SemEval Rest15、Rest16和ACOS数据集上，DRIFT在比较的生成式ASQP方法中实现了最佳性能，在Rest15和Rest16上达到了54.47%和64.10%的F1分数，在短距离和中等距离的方面-观点配置中均取得了持续提升；裁决机制进一步表明，精确匹配指标系统性地低估了语义正确的预测。

articles.title: Training-Free BioNEL-RAG: Advancing Biomedical Entity Linking through Retrieval-Augmented Generation and Large Language Model
articles.abstract: Biomedical Named Entity Linking (BioNEL) is the task of mapping mentions extracted from biomedical texts to canonical entities or concepts in the standardized knowledge base. Although existing methods have achieved remarkable performance in mapping accuracy, most rely on training with domain-specific datasets, which fundamentally limits their cross-domain adaptability. To address this limitation, we propose BioNEL-RAG, a novel training-free framework that combines retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) with large language models (LLMs). Within this framework, the RAG module focuses on retrieving candidate entities, while the large language model module plays the role of selecting the most appropriate candidate for entity normalization, which is based on the analysis of the mention's context, with the aid of its remarkable text comprehension capabilities. Experimental results demonstrate that BioNEL-RAG achieves performance comparable to existing methods without requiring training on subdomain datasets, whereas these methods necessitate fine-tuning on specific subdomains such as genes, diseases, or chemical compounds.
articles.titleCn: 无训练BioNEL-RAG：通过检索增强生成和大型语言模型推进生物医学实体链接
articles.abstractCn: 生物医学命名实体链接（BioNEL）是指将从生物医学文本中提取的提及映射到标准化知识库中的规范实体或概念的任务。尽管现有方法在映射准确性方面取得了显著性能，但大多数依赖于特定领域数据集进行训练，这从根本上限制了它们的跨领域适应性。为解决这一局限性，我们提出了BioNEL-RAG，这是一个无需训练的新颖框架，它结合了检索增强生成（RAG）与大语言模型（LLMs）。在该框架中，检索模块专注于检索候选实体，而大语言模型模块则负责根据提及的上下文分析，利用其卓越的文本理解能力，选择最合适的候选实体进行规范化。实验结果表明，BioNEL-RAG在不需在子域数据集上进行训练的情况下，实现了与现有方法相当的性能，而现有方法则需要在基因、疾病或化学化合物等特定子域上进行微调。

articles.title: Who Receives Respect? A Counterfactual Benchmark for Honorific Allocation Bias in Bengali
articles.abstract: Bengali has no grammatical gender, but honorificity is obligatory: every third-person reference must choose ordinary or respectful register. English has no such signal, so the system must choose a level of deference that the source never specified. We use this property to measure how large language models (LLMs) allocate respect in English--Bengali translation. Our evaluation set contains 2{,}016 sentences across 72 occupations. Each appears in seven sentence frames under four pronoun conditions. Masculine and feminine versions differ by one word, forming counterfactual pairs. We report a single Honorific Bias Score (HBS) for each model on a 0--100 scale, covering both the gender and occupation axes. A lower score means that respect is allocated more evenly. For the occupation analysis, we compute each occupation's honorific rate across the seven no-pronoun sentence frames. The standard deviation of these 72 occupation-level rates ranges from 17.2 to 35.5 percentage points across models, showing substantial variation in how honorifics are allocated across occupations. Occupation is associated with 3.2\% to 51.5\% of the variance in register choice, compared with at most 1.2\% for gender. Gender effects are much smaller overall: only two of the nine models show significant directional gender gaps, and they favor opposite genders. HBS ranges from 19.9 to 70.1 across the nine models, showing substantial variation in how evenly the models allocate respect.
articles.titleCn: 谁会得到尊重？孟加拉语敬语分配偏差的对照基准
articles.abstractCn: 孟加拉语没有语法性别，但敬语是强制性的：所有第三人称指称都必须选择普通或尊敬的语域。英语没有这种信号，因此系统必须选择一个源文本未指定的尊重程度。我们利用这一特性来衡量大型语言模型（LLM）在英语-孟加拉语翻译中如何分配尊重。我们的评估集包含72个职业的2016个句子。每个句子在四种代词条件下出现七个句子框架。阳性和阴性版本仅一字之差，形成反事实对。我们对每个模型报告一个0-100分的敬语偏差分数（HBS），涵盖性别和职业两个维度。分数越低表示尊重分配越均衡。在职业分析中，我们计算每个职业在七个无代词句子框架中的敬语率。这72个职业级别的率的标准差在模型间从17.2到35.5个百分点不等，显示出职业间敬语分配的显著差异。职业与语域选择变异的关联度为3.2%至51.5%，而性别最多仅为1.2%。性别效应总体较小：只有两个九个模型显示出显著的性别差异，且它们倾向于不同的性别。HBS在九个模型间从19.9到70.1不等，显示出模型分配尊重的显著差异。

articles.title: CUSE: Fine-Grained Multimodal Unlearning with Counterfactual Guidance and On-Policy Self-Distillation
articles.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can reproduce sensitive, copyrighted, or unsafe information from their training data. Effective unlearning must remove target information while preserving non-target content, even within the same response. Existing methods typically apply uniform forgetting objectives to complete responses and rely on fixed, off-policy supervision, resulting in coarse token control and misalignment with the model's current behavior. We propose CUSE, a Counterfactual-guided Unlearning framework via on-policy Self-distillation for multimodal large language models. It first constructs counterfactual inputs by removing target-related evidence and uses the resulting changes in token probabilities to identify which tokens require stronger forgetting. It then distills token-level forgetting and retention targets on responses sampled from the current policy, with a frozen copy of the original model serving as the teacher model augmented with the corresponding forgetting- and retention-oriented privileged contexts. This design jointly determines what to forget and what to preserve. On MLLMU-Bench, CUSE reduces forget-set ROUGE-L by 33.6% while achieving 1.2% higher retain-set ROUGE-L than the strongest baseline.
articles.titleCn: CUSE：基于反事实指导和在线策略自蒸馏的细粒度多模态去学习
articles.abstractCn: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）可能从其训练数据中复现敏感、受版权保护或有害信息。有效的去学习必须去除目标信息，同时保留非目标内容，即使在同一响应中也是如此。现有方法通常对完整响应应用统一的遗忘目标，并依赖固定的离策略监督，导致粗粒度的标记控制，且与模型的当前行为不匹配。我们提出了CUSE，一个基于反事实指导、通过策略自蒸馏的多模态大语言模型去学习框架。它首先通过移除与目标相关的证据构建反事实输入，并利用由此产生的标记概率变化来识别需要更强遗忘的标记。然后，它对从当前策略中采样的响应进行标记级别的遗忘和保留目标蒸馏，其中原始模型的冻结副本作为教师模型，并附加相应的遗忘和保留导向的特权上下文。这种设计共同决定了要遗忘什么以及要保留什么。在MLLMU-Bench上，CUSE将遗忘集ROUGE-L降低了33.6%，同时比最强基线在保留集ROUGE-L上提高了1.2%。

articles.title: The Constitution Speaks Nheengatu: An Open MT System and Reproducible Corpus Pipeline for the Amazonian Língua Geral
articles.abstract: Nheengatu (yrl), the Amazonian Língua Geral, has 6--10 thousand speakers and is co-official in São Gabriel da Cachoeira (Brazil), yet remains poorly served by evaluated Portuguese--Nheengatu MT resources. We present the largest parallel corpus assembled for the language (14.5k Portuguese--Nheengatu pairs), anchored by the 2023 official translation of the Brazilian Federal Constitution; the first MT evaluation set built from transcribed spontaneous speech; and, to our knowledge, the first open-weight MT models dedicated to bidirectional Portuguese--Nheengatu translation. Three findings organize the paper. First, translation into Nheengatu on held-out constitutional articles plateaus on development data regardless of training length or model size, and much of the remaining error sits in conventional legal terms that the written sources do not attest consistently; a terminology success rate over a frozen lexicon shows that glossary mechanisms at training time and lexical constraints at decoding each raise term realization, the latter at a cost in repetitive output that chrF++ barely registers. Second, a corpus expansion that adds transcribed conversation raises speech chrF++ by 24--27 points while leaving written domains unchanged, a register gap that written-only benchmarks cannot see. Third, a larger NLLB model helps translation into Portuguese but not into Nheengatu on legal or speech text. For Portuguese-to-Nheengatu translation, our final systems reach 31.7--32.8 chrF++ on article-disjoint constitutional text, 64.1--64.5 on the near-domain set (62.1 after removing items with target-side content overlap), and 45.2--47.5 on speech.
articles.titleCn: 《宪法之声：尼恩加图语开放机器翻译系统及亚马逊利瓜语可复现语料库流程》
articles.abstractCn: Nheengatu（yrl）是亚马逊地区通用语，有6至10千名使用者，在巴西桑加维尔的卡舒埃拉市（São Gabriel da Cachoeira）是官方语言之一，但现有的葡萄牙语-Nheengatu机器翻译资源对其支持不足。我们提出了为该语言汇编的最大平行语料库（14.5k葡萄牙语-Nheengatu对），以2023年巴西联邦宪法的官方翻译为基础；构建了首个基于转录自发性语音的机器翻译评估集；据我们所知，这是首个用于双向葡萄牙语-Nheengatu翻译的开权重的机器翻译模型。本文围绕三个发现展开。首先，在保留的宪法文章上进行的Nheengatu翻译，无论训练时长或模型大小如何，在发展数据上都会停滞，而剩余的错误大多存在于书面来源未一致证明的传统法律术语中；在冻结词汇表上的术语成功率表明，训练时的词汇表机制和解码时的词汇约束都提高了术语实现，后者以重复输出的代价为代价，chrF++几乎未察觉。其次，增加转录对话的语料库扩展使语音chrF++提高了24至27个点，而书面领域保持不变，这种语域差距是仅基于书面的基准无法看到的。第三，较大的NLLB模型有助于葡萄牙语到法律或语音文本的翻译，但对Nheengatu到葡萄牙语的翻译没有帮助。对于葡萄牙语到Nheengatu的翻译，我们的最终系统在文章不重叠的宪法文本上达到31.7至32.8 chrF++，在近领域集上达到64.1至64.5（去除目标侧内容重叠项后为62.1），在语音上达到45.2至47.5。

articles.title: Amharic-English Cross-Language Question Answering Using Statistical Machine Translation, Named Entity Recognition, and Semantic Indexing
articles.abstract: The predominance of English-language Web content creates an information-access barrier for speakers of low-resource languages such as Amharic. This paper presents the design, imple-mentation, and evaluation of a bidirectional Amharic-English cross-language question answering (CLQA) system that allows a user to formulate a natural-language question in either Amharic or English and retrieve an answer from documents written in the other language. The system integrates a statistical machine translation (SMT) component for query translation, a maximum-entropy named entity recognition (NER) component for Amharic text processing, semantic-based indexing, question analysis, passage retrieval, and answer extraction. A domain-diverse Amharic-English parallel corpus was used to train the SMT component, while monolingual cor-pora supported language modeling. Documents were normalized, tokenized, stemmed, indexed, and semantically enriched before retrieval. The original evaluation used precision and recall as the principal effectiveness measures. For Amharic-to-English retrieval, the system achieved 72% precision and 79% recall; for English-to-Amharic retrieval, it achieved 65% precision and 70% recall. These findings show that a modular translation-and-retrieval architecture can provide useful cross-language access even under low-resource conditions. This revised article preserves the original experimental claims while situating them in the context of subsequent multilingual transformer and Amharic QA research.
articles.titleCn: 使用统计机器翻译、命名实体识别和语义索引进行阿姆哈拉语-英语跨语言问答
articles.abstractCn: 英语网络内容的优势为低资源语言（如阿姆哈拉语）的使用者带来了信息获取障碍。本文介绍了双向阿姆哈拉语-英语跨语言问答（CLQA）系统的设计、实现与评估，该系统允许用户用阿姆哈拉语或英语提出自然语言问题，并从另一种语言的文档中检索答案。该系统集成了用于查询翻译的统计机器翻译（SMT）组件、用于阿姆哈拉语文本处理的最大熵命名实体识别（NER）组件、基于语义的索引、问题分析、段落检索和答案提取。使用领域多样的阿姆哈拉语-英语平行语料库训练SMT组件，而单语语料库支持语言建模。在检索前，文档会进行规范化、分词、词干提取、索引和语义丰富。原始评估以精确率和召回率作为主要有效性指标。在阿姆哈拉语到英语的检索中，系统达到了72%的精确率和79%的召回率；在英语到阿姆哈拉语的检索中，系统达到了65%的精确率和70%的召回率。这些结果表明，即使在低资源条件下，模块化的翻译与检索架构也能提供有效的跨语言访问。本文修订版保留了原始实验主张，同时将其置于后续多语言Transformer和阿姆哈拉语问答研究的背景下。

articles.title: Vela: User Behavior as Supervision Sparks LLM Intelligence
articles.abstract: Large language models are increasingly deployed in applications that act on users' long-term behavior histories, from personal assistants to recommendation and advertising systems. These applications demand the user dimension of LLM intelligence: inferring a person's preferences, intent, and likely future actions from weeks to years of behavior data. Yet current models are trained on static text or synthetic data, neither of which captures how user behavior evolves over time. Real-world behavior records, already available at scale on content platforms and in personal-assistant agents, offer a natural supervisory signal. We propose user behavior as supervision and introduce Vela, a framework that converts real user behavior data into trainable tasks and trajectories. From the anonymized behavior records of 100,000 users, Vela generates 100,000 tasks across 91 real-world task templates; difficulty-based filtering and trajectory acceptance criteria retain approximately 75,000 tasks with selected training trajectories. Fine-tuning Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on these trajectories improves performance over the base model by up to 11.5 points on user-related tasks and by an average of 4 points on general benchmarks. Training on more user behavior data further improves user-related performance, and reinforcement learning after fine-tuning outperforms reinforcement learning from the base model by up to 7.7 points. These gains suggest that real-world user behavior is a scalable source of supervision for both user-centered capabilities and the broader intelligence of LLMs.
articles.titleCn: Vela：用户行为作为监督激发大语言模型智能
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型正越来越多地应用于基于用户长期行为历史记录的应用场景，从个人助手到推荐系统和广告系统。这些应用要求LLM具备用户维度的智能：通过数周到数年的行为数据推断用户的偏好、意图和可能的未来行为。然而，当前模型是在静态文本或合成数据上进行训练的，这两种方式都无法捕捉用户行为随时间的变化。内容平台和个人助手代理中已经大规模可用的真实行为记录，提供了自然的监督信号。我们提出将用户行为作为监督信号，并介绍了Vela框架，该框架将真实用户行为数据转换为可训练的任务和轨迹。从10万名用户的匿名行为记录中，Vela生成了覆盖91种真实世界任务模板的10万个任务；基于难度的过滤和轨迹接受标准保留了约7.5万个带有选定训练轨迹的任务。在上述轨迹上对Qwen3.6-35B-A3B进行微调，在使用相关任务时，性能比基础模型提高了11.5分，在通用基准测试中的平均性能提高了4分。使用更多用户行为数据进行训练进一步提升了相关任务的性能，微调后的强化学习表现优于基础模型的强化学习，提高了7.7分。这些提升表明，真实世界用户行为是可扩展的监督信号来源，既适用于以用户为中心的功能，也适用于LLM的更广泛智能。

articles.title: How to Build a Benchmark That Actually Measures Taste
articles.abstract: Expert-aligned "taste" benchmarks should reward craft judgment, not the ability to game the test. We introduce TasteBench, a pairwise good-vs-bad benchmark across visual, brand, book, and tech items under a frozen rubric with expert-only gold (panel n>=3; percent agreement >=0.60 primary gate; weak engagement labels train/analysis-only), together with a control protocol that separates craft judgment from test-gaming. Applying the protocol to a Round-1 pilot (primary_human_expert; three biological human experts; n=250 pairs) surfaces and quantifies three validity threats: two construction artifacts that inflate the trivial-baseline layer, and a difficulty ceiling that inflates every score. (1) Position: the preferred item is slot A with probability 0.956, so an always_item_a policy scores 0.956 (fair chance 0.5). (2) Lexical leakage: a filename token cue scores 0.912. (3) Difficulty ceiling: craft domains show near-ceiling human agreement (book/brand/tech 1.0), and even under A/B randomization (eval_assignment_seed7; gold_side_A ~0.47) all five VLM cards reach 1.0 on craft, with only visual separating (~0.84-0.91; a post-hoc hard subset, n=107, leaves craft at 1.0). The protocol (expert-only gold, a weak-label firewall, side randomization at construction, filename scrubbing, and hard filters) makes each artifact measurable and, for the two construction artifacts, correctable; we release a reference eval harness and a side-randomization tool, and show the tool removes the position skew (0.916 to 0.495/0.505). The result is a calibrated view of what the benchmark does and does not yet measure: position and leakage are fixable, whereas the craft-domain ceiling is a pair-difficulty limit that Round-2 must address. We do not evaluate engagement, era/circle conditioning, or calibration here, and we claim no general taste SOTA.
articles.titleCn: 如何构建一个真正衡量口味的基准
articles.abstractCn: 与专家意见一致的“品味”基准应奖励匠心判断，而非测试作弊的能力。我们介绍了TasteBench，这是一个在视觉、品牌、书籍和技术项目上进行的成对好坏基准，采用冻结的评分标准，仅由专家提供黄金标准（小组n≥3；主要门限的百分比协议≥0.60；弱参与标签仅用于训练/分析），并附带一个将匠心判断与测试作弊分离的控制协议。将协议应用于第一轮试点（主要人类专家；三个生物人类专家；n=250对），揭示了三种有效性威胁：两个导致平凡基线层膨胀的构建伪影，以及一个使所有分数膨胀的难度天花板。（1）位置：首选项目是槽位A，概率为0.956，因此始终选择项目A的策略得分为0.956（公平机会为0.5）。（2）词汇泄漏：文件名标记提示得分为0.912。（3）难度天花板：匠心领域显示出接近天花板的人类协议（书籍/品牌/技术为1.0），即使在A/B随机化下（评估分配种子7；黄金侧A约为0.47），所有五个视觉语言模型卡片在匠心上达到1.0，只有视觉区分（约0.84-0.91；一个后期的困难子集，n=107，使匠心保持在1.0）。该协议（仅限专家黄金标准、弱标签防火墙、构建中的侧随机化、文件名清理和困难过滤器）使每个伪影都可测量，并且对于两个构建伪影，是可纠正的；我们发布了一个参考评估框架和一个侧随机化工具，并表明该工具消除了位置偏差（从0.916降至0.495/0.505）。结果是对基准当前可测量和不可测量内容的校准视图：位置和泄漏是可修正的，而匠心领域的天花板是一个对第二轮必须解决的配对难度限制。在此我们不评估参与度、时代/圈子条件或校准，也不声称有任何一般品味SOTA。

articles.title: Lingdan-V2: Large language models for clinically grounded reasoning in traditional Chinese medicine
articles.abstract: Large language models have advanced medical reasoning, but clinically grounded reasoning in traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) remains challenging because prescription decisions require integrating domain knowledge, syndrome differentiation, treatment principles, herbal prescription composition, and dosage determination. We develop a TCM language model family comprising models with 4 billion, 8 billion, and 14 billion parameters. The artificial intelligence contribution is a staged clinical alignment framework integrating large scale continued pretraining on TCM and clinical records, complementary reasoning supervision, and prescription-centered reinforcement learning (RL). We further formulate herbal prescription generation as a structured RL problem with prescription-level feedback, enabling direct optimization of clinical decision outputs beyond knowledge reproduction and generic instruction following. The engineering application is TCM clinical decision support, particularly herbal prescription recommendation. We evaluate the models on a public benchmark containing 25,620 expert-verified items across 13 TCM knowledge and clinical reasoning tasks and on a private retrospective dataset of 4,348 spleen and stomach disease prescription cases. The 14 billion parameter reinforcement aligned model achieves a prescription generation F1 of 37.0 on the public benchmark, compared with 32.3 for DeepSeek-R1 with 671 billion total parameters, and a herb-level F1 of 52.8 on the clinical dataset with improved dosage agreement. Reinforcement post-training consistently improves prescription recommendation across all scales, while physician-source analysis shows that expert heterogeneity affects reward stability. These findings demonstrate a scalable pathway from domain grounding and reasoning supervision to clinically oriented prescription decision support.
articles.titleCn: 灵丹-V2：基于中医临床推理的大型语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型在医学推理方面取得了进步，但传统中医药（TCM）的临床推理仍然具有挑战性，因为处方决策需要整合领域知识、证候辨析、治疗原则、方剂组成和剂量确定。我们开发了一个包含400亿、800亿和1400亿参数的TCM语言模型家族。人工智能的贡献是一个分阶段的临床对齐框架，集成了基于TCM和临床记录的大规模持续预训练、补充推理监督和以处方为中心的强化学习（RL）。我们进一步将方剂生成制定为一个具有处方级反馈的结构化RL问题，从而能够在知识复现和通用指令遵循之外直接优化临床决策输出。工程应用是TCM临床决策支持，特别是方剂推荐。我们在一个包含13项TCM知识和临床推理任务中25,620个专家验证条目的公开基准数据集以及一个包含4,348例脾胃疾病处方病例的私有回顾性数据集上评估了模型。1400亿参数的强化对齐模型在公开基准数据集上实现了37.0的处方生成F1值，而DeepSeek-R1（总参数量为670亿）为32.3，在临床数据集上实现了52.8的草药级F1值并提高了剂量一致性。强化后训练始终在所有规模上改进处方推荐，而医师源分析表明专家异质性会影响奖励稳定性。这些发现展示了一条从领域基础和推理监督到临床导向处方决策支持的扩展路径。

articles.title: Towards Merging-conditional Backdoor Unalignment against Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Model merging has become widely adopted for enhancing the task-specific performance of Large Language Models (LLMs) without additional training. While the specialized model from third-party platforms may undergo safety audits (e.g., backdoor detection), we reveal a novel and critical threat: One-sided Merging-Conditional Backdoor (OMCB). OMCB remains dormant and undetectable within one standalone model but activates upon merging, triggering safety unalignment. We first theoretically analyze the existence and geometric location of OMCB, revealing that the parameter shift crossing safety decision boundaries is the main cause of backdoor activation. Building upon this insight, we propose SMOKE, a meta-learning-based attack framework. SMOKE implants OMCB via a bi-level optimization strategy: the inner loop synthesizes surrogate meta-vectors through random low-rank initialization and finite-step maximization, while the outer loop optimizes the target model by simulating the merging process. Furthermore, preliminary analysis shows that the injected OMCB has bounded generalization loss under unknown merging configurations. Extensive experiments across diverse model architectures and merging techniques validate the effectiveness of SMOKE and its resistance to existing backdoor detections, highlighting a significant yet previously overlooked vulnerability in the model merging paradigm.
articles.titleCn: 迈向针对大型语言模型的合并条件后门非对齐
articles.abstractCn: 模型融合已被广泛采用，以在不进行额外训练的情况下提升特定任务的大型语言模型（LLM）的性能。虽然第三方平台提供的专用模型可能经过安全审计（例如，后门检测），但我们揭示了一种新颖且关键威胁：单边融合条件后门（OMCB）。OMCB在一个独立模型中保持休眠且难以检测，但在融合时被激活，从而引发安全不匹配。我们首先从理论上分析了OMCB的存在及其几何位置，揭示参数偏移跨越安全决策边界是后门激活的主要原因。基于这一见解，我们提出了SMOKE，一个基于元学习的攻击框架。SMOKE通过双层优化策略植入OMCB：内层通过随机低秩初始化和有限步数最大化合成替代元向量，外层通过模拟融合过程优化目标模型。此外，初步分析表明，在未知融合配置下，注入的OMCB具有有界的泛化损失。跨多种模型架构和融合技术的广泛实验验证了SMOKE的有效性及其对现有后门检测的抵抗能力，突显了模型融合范式中一个重要但此前被忽视的漏洞。

articles.title: VoTSpeech: Decoupling Voice Design from Speech Generation in Instruction-Following TTS
articles.abstract: Instruction-following text-to-speech (TTS) typically leaves voice design implicit, as conventional speaker embeddings encode reference audio rather than text-driven targets. We propose VoTSpeech, which decouples voice design from speech generation via an explicit intermediate voice latent. Built on a shared language model backbone, VoTSpeech first predicts a continuous voice latent from text instructions using a flow-based module. This latent serves as a shared condition for both the language model and the Acoustic DiT, guiding autoregressive sequence modeling and acoustic latent generation, respectively, before an audio VAE decoder converts the acoustic latents into waveforms. To capture speaker identity and complementary acoustic nuances, the voice latent is jointly supervised by speaker embeddings and temporally pooled audio VAE features. With task-specific adaptation, VoTSpeech performs strongly on InstructTTSEval-ZH, demonstrating competitive capabilities against strong open-source models while maintaining high naturalness. These results confirm that explicit voice latent design and its conditioning interface effectively empower text-driven voice design for controllable speech synthesis. Code, model, and audio samples are available at https://github.com/ywbn/VoTSpeech .
articles.titleCn: VoTSpeech：在指令跟随式语音合成中，将语音设计与语音生成解耦
articles.abstractCn: 遵循指令的文本到语音（TTS）通常将语音设计隐式化，因为传统的说话人嵌入编码参考音频而非文本驱动的目标。我们提出了VoTSpeech，通过一个显式的中间语音潜在将语音设计与语音生成解耦。基于共享的语言模型主干，VoTSpeech首先使用基于流的模块从文本指令中预测一个连续的语音潜在。该潜在作为语言模型和Acoustic DiT的共享条件，分别指导自回归序列建模和声学潜在生成，然后音频VAE解码器将声学潜在转换为波形。为了捕捉说话人身份和互补的声学细节，语音潜在由说话人嵌入和时序池化的音频VAE特征共同监督。通过特定任务适配，VoTSpeech在InstructTTSEval-ZH上表现出色，在保持高自然性的同时展现出与强大的开源模型竞争的能力。这些结果证实了显式语音潜在设计和其条件接口有效地赋能了文本驱动的语音设计，实现了可控的语音合成。代码、模型和音频样本可在https://github.com/ywbn/VoTSpeech获取。

articles.title: PVFH-Bench: Benchmarking Premise-Induced Visual Fixation Hallucinations in Vision-Language Models
articles.abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have achieved remarkable progress across a wide range of multimodal tasks. However, object hallucination remains a persistent challenge, undermining model reliability in applications such as visual question answering, embodied agents, and human-AI decision support systems. In this paper, inspired by cognitive science studies on perceptual bias, we investigate a new failure mode termed Premise-Induced Visual Fixation Hallucination (PVFH). Specifically, PVFH refers to a premise-induced reasoning error in which models become anchored to visually confusable evidence, accept a false textual premise, and subsequently generate responses about an absent yet visually plausible object. To systematically study this phenomenon, we introduce PVFH-Bench, a benchmark that automatically constructs visually confusable but absent targets and pairs the core hallucination setting with diagnostic subsets to trace how models move from object recognition to Premise-Induced Visual Fixation Hallucination. Experimental results on 10 state-of-the-art LVLMs demonstrate that all evaluated models are highly vulnerable to Premise-Induced Visual Fixation Hallucination. Moreover, we find that explicit chain-of-thought reasoning can further exacerbate this failure mode by encouraging models to overinterpret weak visual cues as supporting evidence for hallucinated objects.
articles.titleCn: PVFH-Bench：用于评估视觉语言模型中前提诱导视觉注视幻觉的基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）在多种模态任务中取得了显著进展。然而，物体幻觉仍然是一个持续存在的挑战，削弱了模型在视觉问答、具身智能体和人类-人工智能决策支持系统等应用中的可靠性。在本文中，受认知科学中关于感知偏差的研究启发，我们研究了一种新的失效模式，称为前提诱导视觉固定幻觉（PVFH）。具体而言，PVFH指的是一种前提诱导的推理错误，其中模型被视觉上易混淆的证据所锚定，接受一个虚假的文本前提，并随后生成关于一个缺失但视觉上合理的物体的回应。为了系统地研究这种现象，我们引入了PVFH-Bench，这是一个基准，它自动构建视觉上易混淆但缺失的目标，并将核心幻觉设置与诊断子集配对，以追踪模型如何从物体识别过渡到前提诱导视觉固定幻觉。在10个最先进的LVLMs上的实验结果表明，所有评估的模型都对前提诱导视觉固定幻觉高度易感。此外，我们发现显式的思维链推理可以通过鼓励模型将微弱的视觉线索过度解读为支持幻觉物体的证据，从而进一步加剧这种失效模式。

articles.title: The Company a Question Keeps: Auditing Open Jev-Style Models for Retrieval
articles.abstract: Jev's documented interface evaluates typed questions independently against shared evidence. We audit request independence in seven open Jev-style checkpoints on 276 constructed three-passage states from 92 TREC retrieval queries. Paired interventions separately change requested questions, displayed evidence, and candidate eligibility. Request expansion induces strict binary flips in 9.1%/8.0% of Nimble's judgments and changes 21.4%/18.9% of selection-or-abstention actions in TREC DL2019/2020 under a threshold of 0.5 fixed before inference. Correct-action rates change by 0.0/+8.2 percentage points, respectively, with 95% query-bootstrap intervals of [-6.0,6.0] and [3.8,12.6]. Field masking traces all 70 request-set flips to the schema fields serialized into each scoring prompt. In Von, fixing a shared separator's position eliminates two eligibility-induced preference flips in selected diagnostic states. Laya-typed's default CUDA path produces five passage swaps without strict binary flips, and both yearly action-change intervals include zero; in an FP32 rerun, its probability movement vanishes at the model's four-decimal reporting resolution.
articles.titleCn: 公司与问题的关系：审计检索式Jev风格模型
articles.abstractCn: 杰夫的文档化接口独立地针对共享证据评估类型化问题。我们对92个TREC检索查询构建的276个三段落状态中的七个开放杰夫风格检查点审计了请求独立性。配对干预分别改变请求问题、显示证据和候选资格。请求扩展在推理前阈值0.5下导致9.1%/8.0%的Nimble判断严格二进制翻转，并改变21.4%/18.9%的TREC DL2019/2020选择或弃权行为。正确动作率分别变化0.0/+8.2个百分点，95%查询引导区间为[-6.0,6.0]和[3.8,12.6]。字段遮蔽将所有70个请求集翻转追踪到序列化到每个评分提示的架构字段。在Von中，固定共享分隔符的位置消除了在选定诊断状态中的两个资格诱导偏好翻转。Laya-typed的默认CUDA路径产生五个段落交换而不发生严格二进制翻转，且每年的动作变化区间均包含零；在FP32重跑中，其概率移动在模型的四舍五入报告分辨率下消失。

articles.title: Decoupling Knowledge Forgetting and Refusal Learning in MLLM Unlearning
articles.abstract: Current evaluations of multimodal unlearning typically focus on whether a model stops outputting target information. This surface-level criterion, however, masks two critical failure modes. First, knowledge suppression techniques often induce confabulation, leading the model to hallucinate facts about the unlearned subject. Second, refusal training merely alters observable behavior without erasing the underlying knowledge; such models might decline open queries but still identify correct answers under multiple-choice probing. To overcome these limitations, we propose Forget-Aware Self-Distillation (FASD). This method is designed to achieve honest ignorance, a state where the model genuinely loses the target knowledge and learns to acknowledge its absence. FASD separates these goals into two complementary channels. The behavior channel distills appropriate refusals from an ignorance-prompted copy of the model itself. Crucially, target tokens are masked from the teacher distribution to avoid accidentally reteaching the forgotten concepts. Simultaneously, the knowledge channel directly suppresses ground-truth answer spans independently of the model's generated responses. Experiments demonstrate that FASD successfully unlearns target knowledge, prevents information leakage in open-ended tasks, and preserves performance on retained data. The resulting model not only forgets the specified information but accurately recognizes the boundaries of its own knowledge. Code and data will be released upon publication.
articles.titleCn: 在MLLM中解耦知识遗忘与拒绝学习
articles.abstractCn: 当前对多模态遗忘学习的评估通常关注模型是否停止输出目标信息。然而，这一表面标准掩盖了两种关键失效模式。首先，知识抑制技术常导致虚构，使模型对已遗忘的主题产生幻觉。其次，拒绝训练仅改变可观察行为，并未消除底层知识；此类模型可能拒绝开放式查询，但在多项选择探测下仍能识别正确答案。为克服这些局限，我们提出遗忘感知自蒸馏（FASD）方法。该方法旨在实现诚实无知状态——模型真正失去目标知识并学会承认其缺失。FASD将这两个目标分解为两个互补通道。行为通道从自身基于无知提示的副本中蒸馏恰当的拒绝行为。关键在于，教师分布中的目标标记被屏蔽，以避免意外重教被遗忘的概念。同时，知识通道直接抑制真实答案跨度，独立于模型生成响应。实验证明，FASD成功实现了目标知识遗忘，防止开放式任务中的信息泄露，并保持保留数据的性能。所得模型不仅忘记指定信息，还能准确识别自身知识边界。代码和数据将在发表时公开。

articles.title: Fine-Tuning Strategy, Not Just Data: A Statistically Rigorous Audit of Gender and Stereotypical Bias in Embedding Models for HR Recommendation Systems
articles.abstract: Embedding models underpin modern job-candidate matching: resumes, job descriptions, and queries are encoded as dense vectors, and recommendations come from nearest-neighbor retrieval over that space. Any social bias in the embeddings therefore feeds directly into HR recommendations. We audit six multilingual sentence-embedding models (LaBSE- and E5-family, both public and custom fine-tuned) using Bias-in-Bios (occupational gender bias) and StereoSet (stereotypes across profession, race, gender, and religion). We treat statistical validity as a first-class concern: we identify a non-independence error in a naive significance test, where pooling non-independent pairwise similarities inflated a trivial 0.0046 mean difference to $p \approx 0$, and replace it with a profession-level paired Wilcoxon signed-rank test, individual-resampling bootstrap confidence intervals, and permutation tests for StereoSet. Under the corrected methodology, knowledge-distillation (KD) fine-tuning of E5-Base significantly increases measured bias on Bias-in-Bios ($Δ= -0.177$, $p < 10^{-8}$; more negative means more bias), although this measure is sensitive to global embedding geometry. The KD result is corroborated by pro-stereotype patterns in the StereoSet profession category (uncorrected $p < 0.05$). Binary-classification fine-tuning of the same base model shows no statistically distinguishable change ($p = 0.218$). Fine-tuning strategy is thus an actionable design lever for practitioners building HR recommenders. We also report which benchmark categories are underpowered, and note that two domain-adapted models could not be included in significance testing due to a software-access constraint, which limits our conclusions.
articles.comment: 8 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. Accepted at RecSys in HR '26 (The 6th Workshop on Recommender Systems for Human Resources)
articles.titleCn: 精调策略，而非仅数据：对人力资源推荐系统中嵌入模型性别与刻板印象偏见进行严格统计审计
articles.abstractCn: 嵌入模型是现代职位候选人匹配的基础：简历、职位描述和查询都被编码为密集向量，推荐结果来自该空间中的最近邻检索。因此，嵌入中的任何社会偏见都会直接反映到人力资源推荐中。我们使用Bias-in-Bios（职业性别偏见）和StereoSet（跨职业、种族、性别和宗教的刻板印象）审计了六种多语言句子嵌入模型（LaBSE和E5系列，包括公开和定制微调的模型）。我们将统计有效性视为首要关注点：我们发现朴素显著性检验中存在非独立性错误，其中对非独立成对相似度的合并夸大了微不足道的0.0046均值差异至$p \approx 0$，并替换为职业级别的配对Wilcoxon符号秩检验、个体重抽样引导置信区间以及StereoSet的置换检验。在修正后的方法下，E5-Base的知识蒸馏（KD）微调显著增加了Bias-in-Bios上的测量偏见（Δ= -0.177，$p < 10^{-8}$；更负的值表示更多偏见），尽管该指标对全局嵌入几何敏感。KD结果通过StereoSet职业类别的支持刻板印象模式得到证实（未校正$p < 0.05$）。同一基础模型的二分类微调显示没有统计学上可区分的变化（$p = 0.218$）。因此，微调策略是构建人力资源推荐系统的实践者可采取的设计杠杆。我们还报告了哪些基准类别效力不足，并指出由于软件访问限制，有两个领域适应模型未能包含在显著性测试中，这限制了我们的结论。

articles.title: Uniform Information Density-Based Preference Optimization
articles.abstract: To enable large language models to generate outputs that align with human preferences, optimization algorithms based on the comparison between chosen and rejected output pairs have been developed and been proven effective. Some recent endeavors have utilized certain linguistically-derived assumptions about the preference pairs to guide the design of more precise optimization directions. However, human preferences are complex and hard to measure by simplistic criteria, and it is important to incorporate broader and more sophisticated insights about preferred vs. not-preferred language. In this study, we adopt a well-established psycholinguistic theory, Uniform Information Density, to develop a novel preference optimization algorithm, UIDPO. The basic assumption is that humans prefer to produce language in which information is uniformly distributed, because uniformity induces less cognitive processing effort. To implement this idea into the algorithm, we derive a compound metric for information uniformity by combining the global standard deviation and the local second-order difference, and integrate it to the objective of preference optimization. We compare UIDPO with SimPO, a previous state-of-the-art method, obtaining comparable and sometimes better performance on AlpacaEval2, ArenaHard, and MT-Bench. Additional linguistic analysis on complement clauses also shows that UIDPO can better reflect the tendencies of keeping information uniform in natural language than baselines. Our results show that the subtle human preference over the information rate in language is a helpful source for achieving better human alignment for LLMs. The code repository is published here: https://github.com/CLCS-SUSTech/UIDPO.
articles.titleCn: 基于统一信息密度的偏好优化
articles.abstractCn: 为了使大型语言模型能够生成符合人类偏好的输出，研究人员已经开发出基于选择与拒绝输出对比较的优化算法，并已证明其有效性。近期的一些研究尝试利用某些源自语言的偏好对假设来指导更精确的优化方向设计。然而，人类偏好复杂且难以通过简单标准进行衡量，因此，将更广泛、更复杂的关于偏好与不偏好语言的理解融入优化过程至关重要。在本研究中，我们采用成熟的心理学语言理论“均匀信息密度”（Uniform Information Density）来开发一种新的偏好优化算法，即UIDPO。其基本假设是，人类倾向于生成信息均匀分布的语言，因为均匀性能减少认知处理负担。为了将这一理念融入算法，我们通过结合全局标准差和局部二阶差分来推导出信息均匀性的复合指标，并将其整合到偏好优化的目标函数中。我们将UIDPO与之前的顶尖方法SimPO进行比较，在AlpacaEval2、ArenaHard和MT-Bench上取得了相当甚至更好的性能。对补语句的额外语言分析也表明，与基线相比，UIDPO能更好地反映自然语言中保持信息均匀性的趋势。我们的结果表明，人类对语言信息率的微妙偏好是实现LLM更好人类对齐的有益来源。代码库已发布在：https://github.com/CLCS-SUSTech/UIDPO。

articles.title: Reward-Aligned Distillation
articles.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards improves the reasoning capabilities of large language models, but remains computationally expensive and sample inefficient. On-policy distillation (OPD) provides dense token-level supervision from a stronger teacher, yet standard OPD distills every token regardless of whether the teacher's preference actually improves task reward. Existing token-selection methods rely on proxies such as uncertainty or teacher--student divergence, which need not identify reward-improving supervision. We introduce Reward-Aligned Distillation (RAD), a bilevel framework that weights distillation signals based on their predicted effect on the student's post-update reward. RAD differentiates through a temporary optimizer step to score each token's supervision, then updates the token weights by projected ascent from the initial token weights. The resulting weights can strengthen, suppress, or reverse individual distillation-gradient contributions. At a matched training-response budget, RAD improves mean accuracy on six competition-math benchmarks over the strongest baselines by 6.5 percentage points for Qwen3-1.7B (non-thinking) and 2.5 points for Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507. RAD-Simple, a simplified variant, achieves comparable math accuracy at the same training-response budget. On LiveCodeBench-v6, RAD reaches 54.69\% and 58.67\% pass@1 with Qwen3-1.7B (non-thinking) and OLMo3-7B-Instruct, respectively, exceeding the strongest baselines by 8.7 and 6.4 points. These results support reward-guided weighting of teacher supervision across model families and tasks.
articles.titleCn: 奖励对齐蒸馏
articles.abstractCn: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习提升了大型语言模型的推理能力，但仍然计算成本高昂且样本效率低下。策略蒸馏（OPD）能从更强的教师模型中提供密集的标记级监督，但标准OPD会蒸馏所有标记，而无论教师模型的偏好是否真正提升了任务奖励。现有的标记选择方法依赖于不确定性或教师-学生发散等代理指标，这些方法并不需要识别能提升奖励的监督。我们引入了奖励对齐蒸馏（RAD），这是一个双层框架，根据蒸馏信号对学生更新后奖励的预测效果来加权这些信号。RAD通过临时优化器步骤对每个标记的监督进行评分，然后通过从初始标记权重进行投影上升来更新标记权重。得到的权重可以增强、抑制或反转单个蒸馏梯度贡献。在匹配的训练响应预算下，RAD使Qwen3-1.7B（非思考型）在六个竞赛数学基准上的平均准确率比最强基线提高了6.5个百分点，Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507提高了2.5个百分点。简化的变体RAD-Simple在相同的训练响应预算下实现了相当的数学准确率。在LiveCodeBench-v6上，RAD使用Qwen3-1.7B（非思考型）和OLMo3-7B-Instruct分别达到了54.69%和58.67%的pass@1，分别超过了最强基线8.7和6.4个百分点。这些结果支持跨模型系列和任务对教师监督进行奖励引导的加权。

articles.title: LongHisDoc: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Chinese Long Historical Document Understanding
articles.abstract: Chinese historical documents are invaluable cultural treasures, but their complexity poses significant comprehension challenges for non-specialists. Despite the success of Large Language Models (LLMs) and Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) in modern document tasks, their capabilities in Long (full-book) Historical Document understanding remain largely unexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce LongHisDoc, the first benchmark tailored for long historical document understanding. LongHisDoc comprises 1,012 expert-annotated QA pairs derived from 101 PDF documents, with an average of 85.1 pages and 42,776.4 tokens per document. It spans 10 categories and features four QA types: single-page, cross-page, multi-hop, and unanswerable. Answering these questions requires integrating multimodal evidence from text, layout, and visual elements. Our evaluation reveals that the top-performing LVLM and LLM achieve only 62.9% and 69.9% accuracy, respectively, highlighting a substantial performance gap. Furthermore, we assess various modal retrievers and the end-to-end RAG performance to provide references for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems. We believe that LongHisDoc serves as a comprehensive benchmark to catalyze future research in full-book historical document understanding. The benchmark and evaluation code are available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/qweq12433454/LongHisDoc and https://github.com/SCUT-DLVCLab/LongHisDoc.
articles.titleCn: 长历史文档理解综合基准：LongHisDoc
articles.abstractCn: 中国历史文献是无价的文化瑰宝，但其复杂性给非专业人士带来了巨大的理解挑战。尽管大型语言模型（LLMs）和大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）在现代文档任务中取得了成功，但它们在长篇（整本书）历史文献理解方面的能力仍基本未得到探索。为了填补这一空白，我们引入了LongHisDoc，这是首个专为长篇历史文献理解设计的基准。LongHisDoc包含从101份PDF文档中提取的1012份专家标注的问答对，每份文档平均有85.1页和42,776.4个标记。它涵盖10个类别，并具有四种问答类型：单页、跨页、多跳和无解。回答这些问题需要整合文本、布局和视觉元素的多模态证据。我们的评估显示，表现最佳的LVLM和LLM分别仅达到62.9%和69.9%的准确率，凸显了显著的性能差距。此外，我们还评估了各种模态检索器和端到端RAG性能，为检索增强生成（RAG）系统提供参考。我们相信，LongHisDoc作为一个全面的基准，将推动未来整本书历史文献理解领域的研究。基准和评估代码可在https://huggingface.co/datasets/qweq12433454/LongHisDoc和https://github.com/SCUT-DLVCLab/LongHisDoc获取。

articles.title: Query-Adaptive Neuron Steering for LLMs
articles.abstract: Effectively eliciting the capabilities of large language models (LLMs) at inference time remains an important challenge. Existing studies address this challenge through context engineering, which shapes user queries, or fixed steering, which directly intervenes in model computation. However, predefined contexts and fixed intervention strategies may not adequately accommodate the diverse knowledge and reasoning requirements of individual queries. This raises a natural question: Can internal steering in LLMs be made query-adaptive? In this work, we investigate whether query-induced internal activations can guide adaptive steering in LLMs. Our pilot studies reveal subject- and layer-dependent neuron activation patterns and show that amplifying subject-relevant neurons can improve model performance. Based on these findings, we propose Q-NeuS, a query-adaptive neuron steering framework that dynamically determines which neurons to modulate and by how much for each input. Specifically, Q-NeuS constructs a compact subject-guided candidate neuron space and employs a lightweight Query-Adaptive Gate to generate neuron-wise modulation coefficients. To learn effective intervention strategies, we introduce Neu-GRPO, which adapts group-relative optimization to train the Query-Adaptive Gate using the relative performance of multiple neuron intervention configurations. The base LLM remains frozen throughout training and inference, and no task or subject labels are required at inference time. Extensive experiments across multiple LLMs and benchmarks demonstrate that Q-NeuS consistently improves model performance and exhibits broad applicability across model scales and strong cross-benchmark transferability.
articles.titleCn: 针对LLM的查询自适应神经元引导
articles.abstractCn: 在推理时有效激发大语言模型（LLM）的能力仍然是一个重要的挑战。现有研究通过上下文工程（塑造用户查询）或固定引导（直接干预模型计算）来应对这一挑战。然而，预定义的上下文和固定的干预策略可能无法充分满足不同查询的多样知识和推理需求。这就引出了一个自然的问题：LLM内部的引导能否做到查询自适应？在这项工作中，我们研究了查询诱导的内部激活是否能够指导LLM的自适应引导。我们的初步研究表明存在主题和层相关的神经元激活模式，并且放大与主题相关的神经元可以提高模型性能。基于这些发现，我们提出了Q-NeuS，一个查询自适应神经元引导框架，该框架动态地确定对哪些神经元进行调节以及调节的程度。具体而言，Q-NeuS构建了一个紧凑的主题引导候选神经元空间，并采用轻量级的查询自适应门来生成神经元级别的调节系数。为了学习有效的干预策略，我们引入了Neu-GRPO，它将组相对优化应用于训练查询自适应门，使用多个神经元干预配置的相对性能来训练该门。基础LLM在整个训练和推理过程中保持冻结，推理时无需任务或主题标签。在多个LLM和基准测试上的大量实验表明，Q-NeuS始终如一地提高了模型性能，并展现出跨模型规模和强跨基准迁移能力的广泛适用性。

articles.title: AphaVoice: Text-to-Speech Model for Aphasia Patient Simulation
articles.abstract: While language therapy is the primary treatment for post-stroke aphasia, limited clinical resources often restrict patient access to proper care. Addressing this gap requires reliable training simulations for medical professionals. However, current AI efforts focus almost exclusively on speech processing, leaving speech generation largely unexplored. This study introduces AphaVoice, a novel text-to-speech (TTS) framework explicitly engineered to synthesize highly realistic aphasic speech. Evaluated against state-of-the-art TTS systems, AphaVoice demonstrates a superior ability to capture the clinical feature of dysfluency, outperforming existing models in temporal metrics while consistently maintaining speaker identity. By leveraging latent space shifting, the model also supports multi-speaker generation without sacrificing phonetic realism. Ultimately, AphaVoice provides a scalable, high-fidelity tool for medical training and clinical simulation related to aphasia.
articles.comment: Accepted at IEEE Spoken Language Technology (SLT) 2026
articles.titleCn: AphaVoice：用于失语症病人模拟的文本转语音模型
articles.abstractCn: 语言治疗是中风后失语症的主要治疗方法，但有限的临床资源常常限制患者获得适当的治疗。弥补这一差距需要为医疗专业人员提供可靠的培训模拟。然而，目前的AI研究几乎完全集中在语音处理上，而语音生成方面则鲜有探索。本研究介绍了AphaVoice，这是一个专门设计用于合成高度逼真失语症语音的新型文本到语音（TTS）框架。与最先进的TTS系统相比，AphaVoice在捕捉临床上的流畅性特征方面表现出卓越的能力，在时间指标上优于现有模型，同时始终如一地保持说话人身份。通过利用潜在空间偏移技术，该模型还支持多说话人生成，而不会牺牲语音的逼真度。最终，AphaVoice为与失语症相关的医学培训和临床模拟提供了一种可扩展、高保真的工具。

articles.title: Scale, Drivers, and Limits of Representational Alignment Across Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Comparing large language models can reveal shared representational structure and systematic differences between them. However, aggregate similarity measures can obscure how agreement varies across geometric scales and which linguistic properties support it. We introduce two complementary methods to resolve where models agree and what supports that agreement. Standard representational similarity analysis (RSA) summarizes similarity across all stimulus pairs, potentially obscuring differences in alignment between nearby and distant inputs. Neighborhood-Weighted RSA (NW-RSA) addresses this limitation by weighting stimulus pairs according to their proximity in representational space, placing alignment from local neighborhoods to global geometry on a common scale. Counterfactual RSA (CF-RSA) tests which linguistic properties support alignment by comparing intact representations in one model with representations under controlled linguistic perturbations in another. Across diverse language models, we find strong agreement in coarse representational geometry but substantial divergence in local neighborhoods. Alignment is observed both across broadly sampled natural text and within linguistic equivalence classes that preserve particular aspects of meaning or structure. Counterfactual analyses reveal selective sensitivity: changes to logical scope reduce alignment substantially more than the tested changes to hierarchical syntax, event roles, or discourse structure. Alignment also decreases when sentence structure or lexical meaning is disrupted in word lists and jabberwocky sentences, suggesting that the regularities of natural language support stronger convergence. These findings refine claims of representational universality by showing that strong overall similarity need not imply agreement in how models represent finer linguistic distinctions.
articles.titleCn: 大型语言模型表征对齐的规模、驱动因素和限制
articles.abstractCn: 比较大型语言模型可以揭示它们之间共享的表征结构和系统性差异。然而，聚合相似性度量可能会掩盖模型在几何尺度上的一致性变化，以及哪些语言特性支持这种一致性的问题。我们引入两种互补的方法，以确定模型在哪里达成一致，以及是什么支持这种一致性。标准的表征相似性分析（RSA）总结所有刺激对之间的相似性，可能会掩盖邻近和远距离输入之间对齐的差异。邻域加权RSA（NW-RSA）通过根据表征空间中的邻近程度对刺激对进行加权，解决了这一局限性，将局部邻域的对齐与全局几何结构置于同一尺度上。反事实RSA（CF-RSA）通过比较一个模型中的完整表征与另一个模型中在受控语言扰动下的表征，来测试哪些语言特性支持对齐。在多种不同的语言模型中，我们发现粗粒度的表征几何结构上存在高度一致，但在局部邻域中存在显著差异。对广泛采样的自然文本以及保留特定意义或结构特征的语言等价类内部，都观察到对齐现象。反事实分析揭示了选择性敏感性：逻辑范围的改变比测试的层级句法、事件角色或话语结构的改变显著降低了对齐程度。当词列表和洛丽塔句子中的句子结构或词汇意义被破坏时，对齐程度也会降低，这表明自然语言的规律性支持更强的收敛。这些发现通过表明强整体相似性不一定意味着模型在表征更精细的语言差异方面达成一致，从而细化了表征普遍性的主张。

articles.title: EdgeLLM-Nano: Auditing Polar-Guided Key-Cache Compression and Consistency-Anchored Pruning on a 33.6 MB On-Device Language Model
articles.abstract: Deploying language models (LMs) on the edge presents unique memory, latency, and power challenges absent in high-performance computing. KV-cache compression emerges as a promising approach to address these challenges. However, the effectiveness of current KV-cache compression methods has not been thoroughly examined on edge devices. Moreover, we show that existing evaluation methods do not always involve the KV-cache under test. We propose EdgeLLM-Nano, a measurement study of KV-cache compression using a nano-scale decoder-only LM (transformer) testbed that has 8.39M parameters, i.e., 33.6 MB, to enable end-to-end examination of each backend, seed, and power sample. Our results give a negative verdict for a polar-guided key-cache quantizer (round-to-nearest (RTN) control causes an order of magnitude less damage), as well as a consistency-anchored progressive weight pruner (one-shot magnitude-based pruning performs as well as, if not better). We also introduce Long-Context Decode Fidelity (LCDF) evaluation, a token-by-token examination of teacher-forced log-losses using the KV-cache under test. Unlike perplexity that gives the same 5.461 score to all methods, LCDF distinguishes different KV-cache compression backends thanks to its paired statistics across seeds and effect sizes. Our companion Raspberry Pi 5 measurement shows all compression backends we tested to be less energy-efficient per token compared to uncompressed FP16 inference. Except for KIVI that is close to lossless in terms of LCDF, our findings indicate KV-cache compression can be improved. LCDF offers a simple and effective way of shedding light on KV-cache compression methods, whose negative impacts have been overlooked by perplexity.
articles.titleCn: EdgeLLM-Nano：审计极性引导键缓存压缩和一致性锚定剪枝在33.6 MB设备端语言模型上的表现
articles.abstractCn: 在边缘设备上部署语言模型（LM）面临着高性能计算中不存在的独特内存、延迟和功耗挑战。KV缓存压缩作为一种有前景的方法来应对这些挑战。然而，目前KV缓存压缩方法在边缘设备上的有效性尚未得到充分检验。此外，我们表明现有的评估方法并不总是涉及被测试的KV缓存。我们提出了EdgeLLM-Nano，这是一个使用具有839万个参数（即33.6 MB）的纳米级解码器仅LM（Transformer）测试平台进行的KV缓存压缩测量研究，以实现对每个后端、种子和功耗样本的端到端检验。我们的结果表明，极性引导的键缓存量化器（四舍五入控制造成一个数量级的损害）被判定为无效，而一致性锚定的渐进式权重修剪器（基于幅度的单次修剪表现相当，甚至更好）。我们还引入了长上下文解码保真度（LCDF）评估，这是使用被测试的KV缓存对教师强制对数损失的逐标记检验。与所有方法都给出相同5.461分数的困惑度不同，LCDF由于其跨种子的配对统计和效应量，能够区分不同的KV缓存压缩后端。我们的配套树莓派5测量表明，我们测试的所有压缩后端在每标记的能耗方面均不如未压缩的FP16推理。除了KIVI在LCDF方面接近无损外，我们的研究结果表明KV缓存压缩可以改进。LCDF提供了一种简单有效的方法，揭示了KV缓存压缩方法，这些方法的负面影响被困惑度所忽视。

articles.title: Evaluating Bias in Chinese Large Language Models across Tasks and Registers: Task Operationalization Effects and Irony Classification Risks
articles.abstract: In Chinese content governance, large language models are increasingly used to identify toxic and discriminatory expressions, yet both task operationalization and ironic expression can alter bias measurement readings. We conducted a preregistered multi-task behavioral audit of multiple Chinese large language models. In the content classification experiment, the core panel's classification error rate rose from 10.9% in the formal register to 23.5% in the yinyang (an echoic-irony register) version, a risk difference of +12.7 percentage points. (95% CI [+9.7, +15.7]). Inter-rater agreement was lower in the yinyang register (majority-vote kappa = 0.299), so the increase contains a component of label uncertainty propagation, but the direction of increase was consistent under both adjudicated and majority-vote reference standards. Explicit irony-aware prompts reduced the intervention panel's error rate by 9.6 percentage points. We operationalized the 29 shared proposition anchors into three task forms: social consensus estimation (Form A), high-stakes decision (Form B), and controlled association rating (Form C); independent manipulation checks found that all 58 A-C comparison units received unanimous agreement, whereas the low A-B convergence was confirmed by calibrated majority adjudication (87.8% supporting the minority judgment); on the irony-probe materials, the interactions of B and C relative to A were +0.577 and +1.121, respectively. Thus, when evaluating large language models for Chinese content governance, the effect of task operationalization on bias readings is an empirical question that requires data to answer, and safety evaluation should incorporate the ironic register as a test condition.
articles.titleCn: 跨任务和语域评估中文大型语言模型的偏差：任务操作化效应与讽刺分类风险
articles.abstractCn: 在中国内容治理中，大型语言模型越来越多地被用于识别有毒和歧视性表达，但任务操作化和讽刺表达都可能改变偏见测量读数。我们进行了一项预先注册的多任务行为审计，针对多个中文大型语言模型。在内容分类实验中，核心小组的分类错误率从正式语体中的10.9%上升到阴阳（一种模仿性讽刺语体）版本中的23.5%，风险差异为+12.7个百分点。（95%置信区间 [+9.7, +15.7]）。在阴阳语体中，评分者间一致性较低（多数投票kappa值为0.299），因此增加包含标签不确定性传播的成分，但在裁决和多数投票参考标准下，增加方向一致。明确的讽刺感知提示使干预小组的错误率降低了9.6个百分点。我们将29个共享命题锚点操作化为三种任务形式：社会共识估计（A型）、高风险决策（B型）和受控关联评分（C型）；独立的操纵检查发现，所有58个A-C比较单元均获得一致同意，而A-B的低收敛性通过校准多数裁决确认（87.8%支持少数裁决）；在讽刺探测材料中，B和C相对于A的交互分别为+0.577和+1.121。因此，在评估用于中文内容治理的大型语言模型时，任务操作化对偏见读数的影响是一个需要数据来回答的经验性问题，安全评估应将讽刺语体作为测试条件。

articles.title: Re-executing Coding-Agent Evaluations: Unchanged Decisions and Unresolved Policy Risk
articles.abstract: Executable tests grade large language model (LLM) coding-agent patches for leaderboards, rewards and self-improvement. Two preregistered re-execution studies returned negative results. SWE-bench Pro v1's offline option rejected none of 59 accepted Go patches whose grading configuration changed. Their exploratory, unweighted upper confidence limit is 4.95% under candidate independence, leaving a 3% exposed-patch risk unresolved; the preregistered estimator uses inverse sampling-probability weights. An extension was inconclusive. In a selected stratum, a reconstructed module cache built from the reference solution's dependencies rejected accepted alternatives from four models that passed with their own dependencies. Re-executing 1,929 selected agent-version/task evaluations from the Darwin Gödel Machine's archive preserved best-agent selection and system-variant ranking, with search history and scores of evaluations not rerun fixed. Exploratory host, image and adapted-grader comparisons also preserved them. Seven of 23 disagreements with archived verdicts did not recur on a second host; rebuilt images changed 16 three-run majority verdicts (0.83%) under four-CPU execution. We provide an evidence-to-claim summary, lessons for grader audits and an anonymous replication package. These results concern accepted patches and fixed-history decisions; general policy safety and adaptive-learning robustness require broader evaluations.
articles.titleCn: 重新执行编码代理评估：决策未变，政策风险未解决
articles.abstractCn: 可执行测试对大型语言模型（LLM）编码代理的补丁进行评分，用于排行榜、奖励和自我改进。两项预先注册的重新执行研究返回了阴性结果。SWE-bench Pro v1的离线选项拒绝了59个被接受的Go补丁中没有任何一个，其评分配置发生了变化。在候选独立性假设下，它们的探索性、无权重上限置信区间为4.95%，留下了3%的暴露补丁风险未解决；预先注册的估计器使用逆抽样概率权重。一项扩展研究未能得出结论。在一个选定层中，从参考解决方案的依赖关系构建的模块缓存拒绝了四个模型中通过它们自己的依赖关系被接受的替代方案。从达尔文哥德尔机存档中重新执行1,929个选定的代理版本/任务评估，保留了最佳代理选择和系统变体排名，评估搜索历史和分数保持固定。探索性的主机、图像和适配评分器比较也保留了它们。23个与存档裁决的分歧中有七个在第二个主机上不再出现；重建的图像在四核执行下改变了16个三跑多数裁决（0.83%）。我们提供了证据到主张的总结、评分器审计的教训和匿名复制包。这些结果涉及接受的补丁和固定历史决策；一般政策安全性和自适应学习鲁棒性需要更广泛的评估。

articles.title: Evaluating Semantic Relation Knowledge through Bidirectional Relation Prediction from Gloss Pairs
articles.abstract: Semantic relations organise word senses and are fundamental to lexical semantics. In order to evaluate semantic relation knowledge of large language models (LLMs), we propose a challenging task in which an LLM predicts the relation between two glosses (definitions of senses) presented in two different orders. The predictions for the two orders are evaluated for consistency with the symmetry or asymmetry of semantic relations. Our task is designed for both monolingual and cross-lingual evaluation, allowing us to examine whether relation knowledge remains accessible when the same senses are verbalised through glosses in different languages. We construct a dataset of 3,069 sense pairs, with each sense verbalised in English, Greek, Romanian, Turkish, and Japanese. Experiments with 17 LLMs in zero-shot and five-shot settings reveal generally poor performance. In each setting, only eight LLMs achieve a macro-averaged F1 score significantly above a random baseline, and only one (zero-shot) and two (five-shot) significantly outperform a neural baseline. In particular, LLMs often fail to generate bidirectionally consistent predictions for hypernymy and to make correct predictions for holonymy in either direction. Our results suggest limitations in current LLMs' semantic relation knowledge, both in identifying relations and in respecting asymmetry.
articles.titleCn: 通过词汇对的双向关系预测评估语义关系知识
articles.abstractCn: 语义关系组织词义，是词汇语义学的基础。为了评估大型语言模型（LLM）的语义关系知识，我们提出了一项具有挑战性的任务：LLM预测两个不同顺序呈现的释义（词义的定义）之间的关系。对两种顺序的预测将根据语义关系的对称性或不对称性进行一致性评估。我们的任务设计用于单语和跨语评估，使我们能够检验当同一词义通过不同语言的释义表达时，关系知识是否仍然可用。我们构建了一个包含3,069对词义的数据集，每个词义都用英语、希腊语、罗马尼亚语、土耳其语和日语进行释义。在零样本和五样本设置下对17个LLM进行的实验揭示了普遍较差的性能。在每个设置中，只有八种LLM的宏平均F1分数显著高于随机基线，并且只有一种（零样本）和两种（五样本）显著优于神经基线。特别是，LLM通常无法为超类关系生成双向一致的预测，也无法在任一方向上对整体关系做出正确预测。我们的结果表明，当前LLM在识别关系和尊重不对称性方面都存在语义关系知识的局限性。

articles.title: Neither True nor False: Do LLMs Represent Truth-Value Gaps in Plural Predication?
articles.abstract: Do Large Language Models (LLMs) genuinely grasp the truth conditions of plural descriptions, or do they force every sentence into true or false? We investigate the Homogeneity Gap, a semantic phenomenon where a plural definite (e.g., the kids laughed) and its negation (the kids didn't laugh) are both neither true nor false when only some of the kids laughed, whereas their quantified counterparts (all, not all) remain strictly bivalent. We introduce HomogeneityNLI, a diagnostic dataset of 1,000 minimal-pair items crossing determiner, polarity, and group composition across ten logical conditions. Evaluating seven open-weight models, we uncover a pervasive Bivalence Bias: models assign plural definites their homogeneous truth conditions, reading the kids as all of them and the kids didn't as none of them, yet collapse the truth-value gap into falsity. In the zero-shot setting, no model recognizes the gap for both polarities in more than 15% of scenarios, and negated definites are judged False in 84% of cases. Explicit linguistic rules, chain-of-thought, and enumeration prompts produce unstable, model-specific effects that often entrench the bias. Taken together, our findings indicate that current open-weight LLMs have acquired the truth conditions of plural predication but not its trivalent logic.
articles.titleCn: 既非真亦非假：大型语言模型在复数谓词中是否代表真值鸿沟？
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）是否真正理解复数描述的真值条件，还是将每个句子都强行判断为真或假？我们研究了同质性差距（Homogeneity Gap），这是一种语义现象：当一个复数限定词（例如，“孩子们笑了”）及其否定形式（“孩子们没笑”）在只有部分孩子笑了的情况下都既非真也非假时，而它们的量化对应形式（全部、并非全部）则保持严格的二值性。我们引入了HomogeneityNLI，这是一个包含1000个极小对（minimal-pair）项目的诊断数据集，跨越了限定词、极性和群体构成在十个逻辑条件下的交叉。评估了七个开放权重模型，我们发现普遍存在二值性偏差（Bivalence Bias）：模型将复数限定词赋予同质性真值条件，将“孩子们”解读为“所有孩子”，将“孩子们没”解读为“没有孩子”，但将真值差距压缩为假。在零样本设置下，没有模型在超过15%的场景中同时识别出两种极性的差距，并且否定限定词在84%的情况下被判定为假。显式语言规则、思维链（chain-of-thought）和枚举提示产生了不稳定、模型特定的效果，通常加剧了这种偏差。综合来看，我们的研究表明，当前的开放权重LLM已经习得了复数谓词的真值条件，但并未掌握其三元逻辑。

articles.title: MemForm: Benchmarking Memory Formation Poisoning in LLM Agents
articles.abstract: Long-term memory enables LLM agents to learn from past interactions but exposes memory formation to adversarial influence. Existing studies primarily organize memory poisoning by attack channels, corruption patterns, or lifecycle stages, leaving formation interfaces insufficiently characterized. We formulate Memory Formation Poisoning as adversarial manipulation of the interfaces through which persistent agent memory is produced and committed, and introduce MemForm, a controlled diagnostic benchmark covering five interfaces: Content, Evidence, Scope, Selection, and Path Poisoning. We introduce Selection and Path Poisoning as controlled intervention categories that isolate retention and consolidation order effects, respectively. Each category pairs clean and poisoned conditions with interface-specific controls. Evaluations across six LLMs and two response formats reveal broad susceptibility at all five interfaces under the evaluated memory protocols and implementations. Crucially, authentic experiences with successful outcomes do not guarantee reliable behavior after memory formation: changes to contextual support, retention, or consolidation order can induce undesirable downstream behavior. In particular, consolidation order can alter behavior even with identical retained experiences, depending on the memory formation procedure. Additional analyses show that interface applicability depends on memory architecture and that Path Poisoning susceptibility depends on the updater. The evaluated defenses provide incomplete mitigation that varies by interface. These findings motivate protecting both what is committed to persistent memory and how memory is formed from experiences. Code and data are available at https://github.com/opanhw/memform-code.
articles.titleCn: MemForm：对大型语言模型代理中的记忆形成中毒进行基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 长期记忆使大语言模型代理能够从过去的交互中学习，但也使记忆形成容易受到对抗性影响。现有研究主要根据攻击渠道、损坏模式或生命周期阶段来组织记忆中毒，导致形成接口的描述不足。我们将记忆形成中毒定义为对持久代理记忆产生和提交过程中接口的对抗性操纵，并引入MemForm，这是一个受控的诊断基准，涵盖五个接口：内容、证据、范围、选择和路径中毒。我们引入选择和路径中毒作为受控干预类别，分别隔离保留和巩固顺序效应。每个类别将干净和中毒条件与特定接口控制相匹配。在六个大语言模型和两种响应格式上的评估揭示了在评估的记忆协议和实现下，所有五个接口都普遍易受攻击。关键在于，具有成功结果的真实体验并不能保证记忆形成后可靠的行为：对上下文支持、保留或巩固顺序的更改可能诱导不希望的下游行为。特别是，巩固顺序即使在保留的体验相同的情况下也能改变行为，这取决于记忆形成过程。额外的分析表明，接口的适用性取决于记忆架构，而路径中毒的易感性取决于更新器。评估的防御措施提供了不完整的缓解，且因接口而异。这些发现促使我们保护提交到持久记忆的内容以及记忆如何从体验中形成。代码和数据可在 https://github.com/opanhw/memform-code 获得。

articles.title: Scaling Laws for Multimodal Data Mixtures
articles.abstract: Frontier AI systems are increasingly natively multimodal, jointly pretrained on multiple modalities, such as text, vision, and audio. However, the scientific understanding of the multimodal data mixtures used to pretrain these systems --- how much of each modality to mix, and at what potential interference cost to the others --- is largely absent or gatekept. In this work, we derive data mixing scaling laws for three modalities: text, vision, and audio. Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) increasingly adopt Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures, as MoEs scale efficiently and partially limit cross-modal interference. We therefore use MoEs to conduct 268 experiments ranging from 457M to 8.3B parameters, on up to 150 billion tokens. Our work leads to multiple actionable insights into multimodal data mixing for training MLLMs. First, compute optima are modality-specific: audio modality is model-heavy, favoring scaling parameters over tokens, while text and vision require balanced scaling of model size and data. Second, repeating vision or audio data beyond 2x yields negligible benefits. Finally, cross-modal interactions are highly asymmetric: vision strongly interferes with audio, whereas audio's interference with learning text and vision is negligible. Overall, we provide a principled foundation for understanding the multimodal data mixtures needed to train frontier MLLMs.
articles.comment: Accepted as a spotlight in NeurIPS 2026
articles.titleCn: 多模态数据混合的规模定律
articles.abstractCn: 前沿AI系统正越来越多地原生支持多模态，并在文本、视觉和音频等多种模态上进行联合预训练。然而，用于预训练这些系统的多模态数据混合的科学理解——即如何混合每种模态，以及可能对其他模态造成的潜在干扰成本——在很大程度上缺失或被封锁。在本工作中，我们推导了三种模态（文本、视觉和音频）的数据混合缩放规律。多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）越来越多地采用专家混合（MoE）架构，因为MoE能够高效扩展并部分限制跨模态干扰。因此，我们使用MoE进行了268项实验，参数范围从457M到8.3B，涉及高达1500亿个token。我们的工作为训练MLLMs的多模态数据混合提供了多个可操作的见解。首先，计算最优是模态特定的：音频模态模型密集，倾向于优先扩展参数而非token，而文本和视觉则需要平衡模型大小和数据扩展。其次，重复视觉或音频数据超过2倍将带来微乎其微的收益。最后，跨模态交互高度不对称：视觉对音频的干扰强烈，而音频对学习文本和视觉的干扰则可以忽略不计。总体而言，我们为理解训练前沿MLLMs所需的多模态数据混合提供了原则性基础。
